rows.creator_dept: Egypt Network Assurance & O&M Dept
rows.remark:
Based on the standard non-SDN layer3 solution, for EOR, the service physical interfaces between EOR switches and DC GW routers, between EOR switches and service TOR switches, and between EOR switches and peer-link physical interfaces must be configured. The DAD physical interfaces do not need to be configured. According to the QoS policy of service packets, the port queue scheduling configuration needs to be adjusted on the interface. The be-ef queue uses DRR scheduling, the cs6/cs7 queue uses PQ scheduling, and the be-ef queue uses DRR scheduling ratios of 10, 10, and 20, respectively. 20, 50, and 100, which can be configured on the corresponding service physical interface.

Suggest to configure the following QoS commands on the interfaces.
interface xx //Enter the physical interface view. Configure scheduling between EOR switches and DC GWs, between EOR switches and service TOR switches, and between EOR switches.
 qos drr 0 to 5 //Configure queues 0 to 5 to use the DRR scheduling mode. By default, queues 0 to 7 are scheduled in PQ mode.
 qos queue 0 drr weight 10 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of queue 0 to 10.
 qos queue 1 drr weight 10 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of queue 1 to 10.
 qos queue 2 drr weight 20 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of queue 2 to 20.
 qos queue 3 drr weight 20 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of queue 3 to 20.
 qos queue 4 drr weight 50 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of four queues to 50.
 qos queue 5 drr weight 100 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of queue 5 to 100.
#
rows.creator: Malak Talaat Shokry 84322814
rows.risk_description: Check the QoS configuration of the service EOR switch.
rows.risk_title: EORs for QoS configuration of the service EOR switch.

rows.remark:
Based on the standard non-SDN layer3 solution, for TOR, the physical service interfaces between TOR switches and service EOR switches, between TOR switches and access servers, and between TOR switches and peer-link physical interfaces must be configured. The physical interfaces for DAD detection do not need to be configured. Based on the QoS policy of service packets, adjust the port-queue scheduling configuration on the interface. The be-ef uses DRR scheduling, and the cs6/cs7 uses PQ scheduling. The DRR scheduling ratios of BE-ef queues are 10, 10, 20, 20, 50, and 100, respectively. You only need to configure the DRR scheduling ratios on the corresponding service physical interface.

Suggest to configure the following QoS commands on the interfaces.
interface 100GE //Enter the physical interface view. Configure scheduling between TORs and EORs, between TORs and servers, and between TORs and TORs.
 qos drr 0 to 5 //Configure queues 0 to 5 to use the DRR scheduling mode. By default, PQ scheduling is used. The value ranges from 0 to 7.
 qos queue 0 drr weight 10 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of queue 0 to 10.
 qos queue 1 drr weight 10 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of queue 1 to 10.
 qos queue 2 drr weight 20 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of queue 2 to 20.
 qos queue 3 drr weight 20 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of queue 3 to 20.
 qos queue 4 drr weight 50 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of four queues to 50.
 qos queue 5 drr weight 100 //Set the DRR scheduling ratio of queue 5 to 100.
#

stp bridge-address is not configured

rows.risk_description:
Scenario 1
When the NE version is V100R021C10SPC300, if logic soft errors occur only on the active system control board, and services are configured or service boards are warm/cold reset, an active/standby switchover of system control boards will be triggered; if logic soft errors also occur on the standby system control board, repeated active/standby switchovers of system control boards will be triggered and the NE will be unreachable by the NMS.
Scenario 2
When the NE version is V100R023C10SPC100, if logic soft errors occur only on the active system control board, an active/standby switchover of system control boards will be triggered; if logic soft errors occur on both the active and standby system control boards, repeated active/standby switchovers of system control boards will be triggered and the NE will be unreachable by the NMS.
rows.risk_title: [TN-P-202505] Notice on Precaution for Abnormal System Control Board Switching Causes NE Unreachability Due to Logic Soft Errors on the System Control Board of OSN 9800&9600

rows.risk_description:
Scenario 1
When the NE version is V100R021C10SPC300, if logic soft errors occur only on the active system control board, and services are configured or service boards are warm/cold reset, an active/standby switchover of system control boards will be triggered; if logic soft errors also occur on the standby system control board, repeated active/standby switchovers of system control boards will be triggered and the NE will be unreachable by the NMS.
Scenario 2
When the NE version is V100R023C10SPC100, if logic soft errors occur only on the active system control board, an active/standby switchover of system control boards will be triggered; if logic soft errors occur on both the active and standby system control boards, repeated active/standby switchovers of system control boards will be triggered and the NE will be unreachable by the NMS.
rows.risk_title: [TN-P-202505] Notice on Precaution for Abnormal System Control Board Switching Causes NE Unreachability Due to Logic Soft Errors on the System Control Board of OSN 9800&9600

rows.remark:
1. Run the display transceiver verbose command to view information about all optical modules on the device.
2. Check whether the bias current, receive power, and transmit power of all interfaces are displayed. If no, go to the next step.
3. Check whether the bias current, receive power, and transmit power of all optical interfaces are within the threshold range of the optical module. (If the upper and lower thresholds of the transmit//receive power are set, the thresholds are used for judgment. If the upper and lower thresholds of the transmit/receive power are not set, the default upper and lower thresholds of the transmit/receive power are used for judgment.). If no, record the port number $port and proceed to the next step. Otherwise, the check is not involved.
4. Run the display interface brief command on the device to check the PHY status of all unqualified interfaces $port. If the PHY status is *down, the check is not applicable. Otherwise, go to the next step.
5. If the port status in step 4 is Down and the receive optical power is –40 or –50, the check is not applicable. Otherwise, a risk is reported.

rows.confirm_comment:
[Root Cause]
If a subscriber who is in arrears initiates a call, the SCP changes the called number and sends the changed number to the MSOFTX3000. After receiving the new number, the MSOFTX3000 routes the call to a SIP office direction. However, if the SIP office direction becomes unreachable in this case, the MSOFTX3000 uses the original called number to perform reanalysis and reroutes the call based on the analysis result. As a result, the call is not suppressed.
 
[Impact and Risk]  
Calls initiated by subscribers who are in arrears are not suppressed, causing charging loss.
rows.remark: Eslam Abd El Hakim Ali Mahmoud 00467773
rows.creator: zhuhua 60031404
rows.risk_description:
In 2018 and 2024, the MSOFTX3000 released the precaution notice twice, requiring that bit 2 of P961 be set to 0. However, this was not implemented on the live network. The warning links are as follows:https://support.huawei.com/carrier/docview?nid=SC2200018531&path=PBI1-21262245/PBI1-21435190/PBI1-24030871/PBI1-21782489/PBI1-15663
In 2025, the configuration rectification requirement was released, but this was not implemented on the live network. The rectification link is https://support.huawei.com/carrier/docview?nid=SC2200019471&path=PBI1-21262245/PBI1-21435190/PBI1-24030871/PBI1-21782489/PBI1-15663. 
If the rectification is not performed, there is a risk of charging loss due to calls being connected for subscribers with outstanding fees. For details, refer to the precaution notice.
rows.risk_title: In 2018 and 2024, the MSOFTX3000 released the precaution notice twice, requiring that bit 2 of P961 be set to 0. However, this was not implemented on the live network.

rows.risk_description:
According to the inspection report, critical alarms SWDL_CHGMNG_NOMATCH or SYNC_FAIL exsit on some NEs . 
The SWDL_CHGMNG_NOMATCH alarm indicates a mismatch between the host software and the board software, and the automatic matching function for package loading is turned off.
The SYNC_FAIL alarm indicates a failure in synchronizing the master and slave system control database files.
If the equipment has these alarms, when NE power failure and restart, if the original slave system control board completes power-on startup first, it will automatically dispatch the configuration of the original slave system control board, which may lead to configuration loss and service impact.
rows.risk_title: Check & clear the critical alarms SWDL_CHGMNG_NOMATCH and SYNC_FAIL

rows.remark: Continuous HEART BEAT Should be enabled in the Trunk Route towards the Next HOP
rows.creator: Mohamed Nasr Afify 84372161
rows.risk_description:
[Risk of No Modification]
If heartbeat detection is not enabled, the SBC cannot detect the faulty I-CSCF, causing service failures.
[Benefits of the Modification]
The SBC sends OPTIONS messages to the I-CSCF to perform heartbeat detection. If the I-CSCF is faulty, another I-CSCF that is running properly is selected.
[Impact of the Modification]
The I-CSCF is required to process the OPTIONS messages. If the I-CSCF cannot return 200 (to OPTIONS) messages, the trunk group becomes faulty and route selection changes.
rows.risk_title: [VoLTE Key Configuration Check]Check whether heartbeat detection is enabled on the I-CSCF

This affects the Rx-interface traffic statistics and increases the processing delay in the reselection scenario.

rows.title: 2026 Telecom Cloud Bearer Network Risk Clearance Project-2026年电信云承载网风险消减专项
rows.precaution_title: 2026年电信云承载网风险消减专项
rows.creator: t00803376
rows.risk_description:
[Special background]: In the past two years, more than 20 major issues, such as network accidents, management upgrades, and emergency recovery, have occurred on the Telco Cloud bearer network, and there are still high risks. Based on the value networks where major issues have occurred in the past two years, target networks are selected for this special project.
[Special inspection plan]:
1. The iptoolkit tool is used for data collection, and the solution template matching the live network is used for data collection. (If there are multiple solution scenarios at a site, the corresponding template must be used to collect data separately.)
2. This special inspection integrates the "datacom network health check" and "IP service health evaluation 2.0" (the two "Telco Cloud network scenario" check items are included), aligns the evaluation items in each solution, and adds risk checks such as the availability of the active and standby services.
3. NetCare serves as the entry point for the special inspection (health check module—multiple health check instances need to be created if there are multiple solution scenarios at a site). The "Customized Scenario--2026 Telco Cloud Bearer Network Risk Mitigation Special Project" template is used, and the corresponding scenario template is automatically invoked in the UMC background for risk analysis. (For sites without feedback on the Telco Cloud solution on the live network or on the live network NE data, or sites with multiple solution scenarios, UMC needs to manually select the corresponding scenario and confirm the NE pairing relationship.)

[Special closed-loop solution]:

If one or more datacom products listed in the "Involved Products" section of the current task order (CPTxxxxxxxxxxxxxx) are deployed on the live network, perform the following operations to mitigate risks on the telco cloud transport network.

rows.precaution_title: 关于路由器在特定场景下收到不支持的IPv6报文触发业务受损风险排查
rows.creator: l00203087
rows.risk_description:
[Disposal Method] :
1. Investigate whether the current network involves MPAC data configuration.
Investigation Plan 1 (Recommended): Use inspection tools to investigate, refer to "IPv6 Early Warning Collection and Analysis Guide (IP Toolkit + UMC)".
Investigation Plan 2 (Manual):
1.2.1) Execute the display version command under the user view to check if the device has any issues. The following versions are involved:
1.2.1.1) ATN&NE40E&CX600&ME60&NE8000&NE9000&NE20E&PTN6900&NetEngine A800: All versions of V800
1.2.1.2) ATN: All versions of V300
1.2.2) Execute display current-configuration under the user view to check for service-security policy ipv6 configuration. If present, there is a risk.
<HUAWEI>display current-configuration | include service-security
service-security policy ipv6 test1 //test1 is an example configuration name for MPAC IPv6 policy
2. If the current network devices have MPAC data configuration, provide feedback on the number of involved devices in the task progress, and track until the risk reduction is completed, then close the investigation task.
Risk reduction closure standard: Execute the preventive measures in the early warning or complete the upgrade of the current network devices according to the rectification requirements (rectification plan released online on August 10).
3. If the current network devices are not configured with MPAC, it is not involved. Provide feedback that it is not involved, and the investigation task can be directly closed.
If there are any questions during the risk investigation process, please contact the R&D interface person Wu Haimin at 00483639.

【处置方法】：
1、    排查现网是否涉及MPAC数据配置，
排查方案1（推荐）：通过巡检工具排查，参考《IPv6预警的采集和分析指导 (IP Toolkit + UMC)》
排查方案2（手工）：
             1.2.1）在用户视图下执行display version命令，查看设备是否存在问题。下列版本涉及：
                       1.2.1.1） ATN&NE40E&CX600&ME60&NE8000&NE9000&NE20E&PTN6900&NetEngine A800:V800所有版本
                       1.2.1.2）ATN:V300所有版本
            1.2.2) 在用户视图执行display current-configuration，查看有service-security policy ipv6配置，有则存在风险。
                  <HUAWEI>display current-configuration | include service-security 
                    service-security policy ipv6 test1  //test1是举例配置MPAC IPv6策略名
2、如果现网设备有MPAC数据配置，在任务进展中反馈涉及设备数量，并跟踪到风险消减完成，再闭环排查任务。
风险消减闭环标准：执行完成预警中的预防措施或者根据整改要求完成现网设备升级（整改计划8月10日发布上网）。
3、  如果现网设备未配置MPAC，则不涉及，反馈不涉及，排查任务可以直接闭环。 

如果在风险排查过程中有任何疑问，请联系研发接口人吴海民 00483639

rows.precaution_title: 关于NetEco产品BBUConnectorService证书过期将导致站点断连的风险
rows.creator: y00481579
rows.risk_description:
【Trigger conditions】
The following affected versions , exist in-band channel sites. The BBUConnectorService does not replace the customer certificate and uses the Huawei pre-installed certificate. The preconfigured certificate is not replaced, and the preconfigured certificate expires.
Affected Version：
V600R022C00
V600R022C10
V600R023C00
V600R024C10
V600R024C20
V600R024C30

[Symptom]
After the BBUConnectorService certificate expires, the in-band channel between the NetEco and the base station is disconnected and cannot be reconnected. The in-band channel site is disconnected.
1. The certificate expiration time is 18:56 on January 7, 2027. After the certificate expires, the Certificate Expired alarm is generated
2. If the in-band channel site whose in-band channel connection mode is SSL is disconnected, the connection test result is Other errors.

rows.title: Datacom Frame-shaped Device Rectification Clearance/数通框式整改风险清理
rows.precaution_title: 数通框式整改风险清理
rows.creator: z00211079
rows.risk_description:
Background: Major faults occur on the live network caused by multiple known problems due to factors such as inaccurate IBMS data and missing rectification implementation. To eliminate risks that need to be rectified, this project is developed

Special Solution: Sort out the rectifications released in Datacom domain in the past three years, to match IBMS inventory, UMC risks and RFC, identify the list of suspected sites that have not been rectified, and track and clear the sites through this special maintenance tasks

Closure Condition:

For NEs that have been rectified on the live network:
1. If the NE information is consistent with that in the IBMS, can close the CPT task directly. Remark as "The NEs have been rectified and the IBMS has been updated". The closure condition is to upload the screenshot of the current IB information in the CPT task

2. If the NE information is inconsistent with that in the IBMS, the IBMS needs to be updated. The closure condition is to upload the screenshot of the updated IB information in the CPT task

For NEs that have not been rectified on the live network:
1. If the customer agree to implement the rectification, complete the rectification in 2025 and update the IBMS.
(1) If Huawei implements the rectification with RCxxx ticket, the closure condition is to associate the RCxxx ticket in the CPT task and upload the updated IB information screenshot in the CPT task

(2) If Huawei implements the rectification without RCxxx ticket, the closure condition is to associate the RFC ticket in the CPT task and upload the updated IB information screenshot in the CPT task

(3) If customer implements the rectification, the closure condition is to upload the screenshot of the updated IB information in the CPT task

2. If the customer does not agree to the rectification, obtain effective record filing documents and associate the RCxxx ticket. The closure condition is to associate the RCxxx ticket in the CPT task and upload effective record filing documents in the CPT task

3.If the rectification is delayed to 2026, create RCxxx ticket，obtain effective record filing documents and associate the RCxxx ticket. The closure condition is to associate the RCxxx ticket in the CPT task and upload effective record filing documents in the CPT task，the rectification will be managed as a routine delay at 2026

For NEs that have been offline from the live network: Can close the CPT task directly. Remark as "The NEs have been already offline" and delete the corresponding IBMS inventory information. There is no closure condition


If you have any questions about inspection and risk clearance, contact Zhang Lei (employee ID: 00556734)




专项背景：因IBMS数据不准、整改实施遗漏等因素，导致现网发生多起已知问题引发的现网重大故障，为清理整改应做未做的风险，特开展本专项

专项方案：梳理数通近三年发布的整改，多维度匹配IBMS存量/巡检风险/Netcare变更单，识别出“疑似”未整改局点清单，并通过“专项维护任务”跟踪清理

闭环条件：

对于在网且现网已整改的网元：
1.如果网元信息和IBMS一致，直接闭环，闭环时备注“已整改，且IBMS已刷新”，闭环条件是在CPT风险流程上传当前IB信息截图

2.如果网元信息和IBMS不一致，需要刷新IBMS，闭环条件是在CPT风险流程上传刷新后IB信息截图

对于在网的现网未整改的网元：
1.如果客户决策实施，需要于25年正常完成整改，并刷新IBMS：
(1)如果华为实施，需要整改单：闭环条件是在CPT风险流程关联整改单（整改单里面关联RFC闭环），并在CPT风险流程中上传IB信息截图

(2)如果华为实施，不需要整改单：闭环条件是在CPT风险流程直接关联RFC单，并在CPT风险流程中上传IB信息截图

(3)如果客户实施：闭环条件是在CPT风险流程上传IB信息截图

2.如果客户决策不实施，需要获取有效的备案文件，并关联整改单。闭环条件是在CPT风险流程关联整改单，并在CPT风险流程中上传有效的备案文件

3.如果延期到2026年整改，需要获取有效的备案文件，并关联整改单。闭环条件是在CPT风险流程关联整改单，并在CPT风险流程中上传有效的备案文件，26年作为例行延期整改管理

对于已下线的网元：直接闭环，备注“已下线”，并刷新IBMS存量信息。无闭环条件


如果您对巡检排查和风险清理有疑问，请联系张雷 00556734

rows.creator: z00211079
rows.risk_description:
Background: Major faults occur on the live network caused by multiple known problems due to factors such as inaccurate IBMS data and missing rectification implementation. To eliminate risks that need to be rectified, this project is developed

Special Solution: Sort out the rectifications released in Datacom domain in the past three years, to match IBMS inventory, UMC risks and RFC, identify the list of suspected sites that have not been rectified, and track and clear the sites through this special maintenance tasks

Closure Condition:

For NEs that have been rectified on the live network:
1. If the NE information is consistent with that in the IBMS, can close the CPT task directly. Remark as "The NEs have been rectified and the IBMS has been updated". The closure condition is to upload the screenshot of the current IB information in the CPT task

2. If the NE information is inconsistent with that in the IBMS, the IBMS needs to be updated. The closure condition is to upload the screenshot of the updated IB information in the CPT task

For NEs that have not been rectified on the live network:
1. If the customer agree to implement the rectification, complete the rectification in 2025 and update the IBMS.
(1) If Huawei implements the rectification with RCxxx ticket, the closure condition is to associate the RCxxx ticket in the CPT task and upload the updated IB information screenshot in the CPT task

(2) If Huawei implements the rectification without RCxxx ticket, the closure condition is to associate the RFC ticket in the CPT task and upload the updated IB information screenshot in the CPT task

(3) If customer implements the rectification, the closure condition is to upload the screenshot of the updated IB information in the CPT task

2. If the customer does not agree to the rectification, obtain effective record filing documents and associate the RCxxx ticket. The closure condition is to associate the RCxxx ticket in the CPT task and upload effective record filing documents in the CPT task

3.If the rectification is delayed to 2026, create RCxxx ticket，obtain effective record filing documents and associate the RCxxx ticket. The closure condition is to associate the RCxxx ticket in the CPT task and upload effective record filing documents in the CPT task，the rectification will be managed as a routine delay at 2026

For NEs that have been offline from the live network: Can close the CPT task directly. Remark as "The NEs have been already offline" and delete the corresponding IBMS inventory information. There is no closure condition

rows.title: 2025 Hybrid Video Certificate Risk Mitigation
rows.precaution_title: 2025年融合视频存量证书风险消减专项
rows.creator: l00287791
rows.risk_description:
The following certificates are used. After the certificate expires, alarms may be generated, unreachable to the NMS, or services may be affected.
Multiple certificates (such as RootCA.pem.cer, lb.keystore, tomcatKeyStore, and UniversecertChain.jks) of multiple components of the Envision Video Platform & CDN products.
Multiple certificates (such as signing_cert.pem, uniagent_ca.pem, and cmp.keystore) of the DigitalView product.
Multiple certificates (such as FusionSphere OpenStack class-A certificates, OM class-A certificates, FusionSphere OpenStack SSL certificates, and OM HA certificates) of FusionSphere OpenStack.
Multiple certificates (such as root-ca.crt and server.crt) of FusionInsight.
Note:
1. Number of risky NEs: The Envision Video Platform/CDN calculates the number of NEs based on the number of planned operation windows for performing certificate replacement tasks. Calculate the number of DigitalView/FusionSphere/FusionInsight NEs based on the actual number of DigitalView/FusionSphere/FusionInsight NEs on the live network.
2. If the product involved in the task does not involve certificate risks, change the value of Involved NEs to 0. Upload the check certificate when the problem is closed.

rows.creator: z00600741
rows.risk_description:
If one or more types of S series switches which listed in the 'Involved Product' directory of this task order, are deployed on the live network, should perform the following operations:
1、Complete the risk check for S series switches before September 30, 2024 and complete risk mitigation before December 30, 2024.
2、Closure criteria for the elimination task:
a. Create a health check ticket（HCxxxxxx） and complete data collection and analysis of the firewall two-node cluster network by referring to the attachment (Firewall Hot Standby Collection and Analysis Guide (IP Toolkit + UMC)) in the solution package. After the risk check is complete, the identified risks should be recorded in Netcare. When the task is closed, the health check ticket number and risk ticket number must be associated.
b. If the risk check cannot be completed due to customer reasons, (For example, the customer does not allow inspection or collection, or data cannot be exported due to laws and regulations.) The customer must be formally notified of the risk. Notify the customer of the email or meeting minutes as evidence to close the task.
Note: When eliminating risks, such as configuration adjustment, patch upgrade, and switchover, submit an RFC for review before performing operations.
3. If you have any questions about Inspection Check & Risk Clearance, please contact liulin 00809079；If you have any suggestions or questions about the task, please contact zhangchaoqun 00600741.

rows.title: Risk warning of Expiration of Preset Certificates on Huawei Servers——华为服务器预置证书过期风险预警
rows.precaution_title: 华为服务器预置证书过期风险预警
rows.creator: h84185509
rows.risk_description:
The preset SSL certificate of iBMC earlier than 253 (excluded) and iBMC 663 will expire on July 22, 2024. The preset SSL certificate of E9000 management module (MM910) firmware earlier than 690 (excluded) will expire on February 20, 2024. The preset SSL certificate of all versions of 9008 V5 (supporting CMC)/9032/9016/9008 server chassis management modules (KunLun CMC) will expire on February 20, 2024. After the software certificates expire, the WebUI and Redfish functions can be used properly. Some software or versions will report alarms.
If certificate validity period verification is enabled on the customer's network management system (NMS), the device may be out of management.

iBMC 253(不包含)之前和663版本使用的预置SSL证书将于2024年7月22日过期；E9000管理板MM910固件版本690(不包含)之前版本使用的预置SSL证书将于2024年2月20日过期；9008 V5（Support CMC）/9032/9016/9008服务器机框管理板Kunlun CMC所有版本使用的预置SSL证书2024年2月20日过期。这些软件的证书过期后，web和redfish功能均可以正常使用，部分软件或版本会上报告警。如果客户网管开启了证书有效期校验，可能有脱管风险。

Complete risk mitigation before June 30, 2024 for contracts that will expire in 2024 and before December 30, 2024 for contracts that will expire in 2025 or 2026.

Check risks based on the precaution and the information contained in the risk elimination solution package to ensure that all risks are eliminated.
而影响上层业务，此专项包含两个证书风险；
24年到期的在24年6月30日前完成风险消减，25&26年到期的在24年12月30日前完成风险消减：

rows.title: Datacom firewall HA reliability hardening project in 2024 / 2024年数通防火墙双机可靠性加固专项
rows.precaution_title: 2024年数通防火墙双机可靠性加固专项
rows.creator: r00209145
rows.risk_description:
If one or more types of firewalls which listed in the 'Involved Product' directory of this task order, are deployed on the live network, should perform the following operations to harden the reliability of the firewall two-node cluster.

1、Complete the risk check of the firewall HA system before September 30, 2024 and complete risk mitigation before December 30, 2024.
2、Closure criteria for the elimination task:
a. Create a health check ticket（HCxxxxxx） and complete data collection and analysis of the firewall two-node cluster network by referring to the attachment (Firewall Hot Standby Collection and Analysis Guide (IP Toolkit + UMC)) in the solution package. After the risk check is complete, the identified risks should be recorded in Netcare. When the task is closed, the health check ticket number and risk ticket number must be associated.
b. If the IP Toolkit cannot be used for inspection, the attachment (Firewall Hot Standby Collection and Analysis Guide (IP Toolkit + UMC)) in the solution package provides manual collection and analysis methods. After the risk check is complete, the identified risks should be recorded in Netcare. In closed-loop management, remark the UMC project name and associated risk ticket number.
c. If the risk check cannot be completed due to customer reasons, (For example, the customer does not allow inspection or collection, or data cannot be exported due to laws and regulations.) The customer must be formally notified of the risk. Notify the customer of the email or meeting minutes as evidence to close the task.
Note: When eliminating risks, such as configuration adjustment, patch upgrade, and switchover, submit an RFC for review before performing operations.
3.If you have any suggestions or questions about the task, please contact renshiqi 00549633 or wuhaimin 00483639.

The preset SSL certificate of iBMC earlier than 253 (excluded) and iBMC 663 will expire on July 22, 2024. rows.creator: l84263029
rows.risk_description:
Note:
1. The FusionSphere creates tasks for all software products on the entire network by country and customer network. During the check, you need to check all products (such as CBS/Mobile Money/AAA/VDS/BES/CRM/IPCC & CSP/AICC/EVC/IPTrace).
2. The certificate of installed base software FusionSphere products expires in 2020. The reduction must be completed by December 31, 2024.
3. For details, see the A&S412-20240321 Warning About the Expiration Risks of the PKI Certificate and Other Certificates of the NFV_FusionSphere of the IT Auxiliary.
4. If the certificate expires, associate the risk work order with the task and submit the work order for review after the task is closed based on the task closure conditions.
5. If the certificate expiration is not involved, delete the IBMS device document and report that the certificate expiration is not involved. Then cancel the work order.

说明：
1.FusionSphere是以国家&客户网络为单位给全网所有软件产品创建任务，排查时需要排查所有产品（CBS/Mobile Money/AAA/VDS/BES/CRM/IPCC & CSP/AICC/EVC/IPTrace）
2.2025年软件存量FusionSphere产品证书过期，要求100%完成消减，任务完成时间为2024年12月31日；
3.请参考《A&S412-20240321-关于软件业务产品集成的FusionSphere组件预置证书即将到期的预警通知》排查；
4.若涉及证书过期，在任务中关联风险作业单，根据任务闭环条件完成后提交闭环评审；

rows.title: 2024年存储产品证书到期风险消减专项
rows.precaution_title: 2024年存储产品证书到期风险消减专项
rows.creator: h84185509
rows.risk_description:
In 2024, the risk of pre-installed certificate expiration of storage products is explosive. After the pre-installed certificate expires, alarms indicating that the storage certificate is about to expire or has expired will be reported, which may affect some functions and further affect upper-layer services. There are two certificate risks；
Complete risk mitigation before June 30, 2024 for contracts that will expire in 2024 and before December 30, 2024 for contracts that will expire in 2025 or 2026.
1，[CIT-P-202404]Warning of Expiration for Preset iBMC Certificates of Storage Product Servers；
2，[CIT-P-202410] Notice on Prewarning for Expiration Risk of Certificates in Storage Products；
Check risks based on the precaution and the information contained in the risk elimination solution package to ensure that all risks are eliminated.
2024年存储产品预置证书到期风险呈现爆发趋势，存储产品预置证书到期后，会上报存储证书即将过期、过期告警，可能影响部分功能，进而影响上层业务，此专项包含两个证书风险；
24年到期的在24年6月30日前完成风险消减，25&26年到期的在24年12月30日前完成风险消减：
1，【CIT-P-202404】关于存储产品服务器iBMC预置证书过期风险的预警通知；
2，【CIT-P-202410】关于存储产品证书过期风险的预警通知；
还请根据预警正文信息和风险消除方案包内内包含的各项信息进行风险排查，确保风险清零；

rows.creator: h84185509
rows.risk_description:
The preset SSL certificate of iBMC earlier than 253 (excluded) and iBMC 663 will expire on July 22, 2024. The preset SSL certificate of E9000 management module (MM910) firmware earlier than 690 (excluded) will expire on February 20, 2024. The preset SSL certificate of all versions of 9008 V5 (supporting CMC)/9032/9016/9008 server chassis management modules (KunLun CMC) will expire on February 20, 2024. After the software certificates expire, the WebUI and Redfish functions can be used properly. Some software or versions will report alarms.
iBMC 253(不包含)之前和663版本使用的预置SSL证书将于2024年7月22日过期；E9000管理板MM910固件版本690(不包含)之前版本使用的预置SSL证书将于2024年2月20日过期；9008 V5（Support CMC）/9032/9016/9008服务器机框管理板Kunlun CMC所有版本使用的预置SSL证书2024年2月20日过期。这些软件的证书过期后，web和redfish功能均可以正常使用，部分软件或版本会上报告警。如果客户网管开启了证书有效期校验，可能有脱管风险。

rows.title: 电信云数据第三方备份/Telecom Cloud Data Third-Party Backup
rows.precaution_title: 电信云数据第三方备份
rows.creator: y00543860
rows.risk_description:
多国多运营商陆续出现CloudOS故障，网元虚拟机故障或者丢失，所有上层业务受损或完全中断，由于局点未进行I层数据的第三方备份，业务受损时间长、甚至只能重新部署，局点业务恢复时间不可控。
23年作为TOPN专项任务与各区域CS业务主管，高督做专题沟通。通过NETCARE的风险运营中心按照涉及客户群下发任务到各代表处并进行进展跟踪，专项执行过程中问题通过ITR流程支持，本次要求电信云C面全部实现第三方数据备份。
跟踪闭环措施:
1.电信云第三方备份专项任务关闭必须关联RFC单。
2.将FS、FSOM和Fusionstage数据备份成功任务截图上传TOPN任务，任务可闭环，如果有多个DC，可以将截图按DC站点名字区分，一起上传。
3.如果客户不批准第三方备份，上传客户不同意邮件
Cloud OS faults occur in multiple countries and carriers. The VM of NE is faulty or lost, all upper-layer services are damaged or completely interrupted. As the third-party data backup at the IaaS layer is not performed at the site, the service interruption time is long or even the site needs to be redeployed. The service restoration time is uncontrollable.
Communicated with regional CS business directors and senior supervisors as a special task for TOPN in 2023. The NetCare assigns tasks to rep offices based on the customer groups involved and tracks the progress, the TOP N must be resolved through the ITR process，all C plane of Telcom Cloud must finish third-party data backup,
Tracking and closed-loop measures:
1. The third-party backup task of the telecom cloud must be associated with RFC ticket.
2.Upload the screenshots of successful data backup tasks of FusionSphere, FusionSphere OM, and FusionStage to the top N tasks. The tasks can be closed. If there are multiple DCs, the screenshots can be separated by DC site name and uploaded together.
3.If customer don’t approve the third-party backup, upload customer email

rows.title: Risk check if SSDs are running more than 4 years and their erase/write life will expires in batches // 发货超四年SSD盘，擦写寿命批量到期的风险排查
rows.precaution_title: 发货超四年SSD盘，擦写寿命批量到期的风险排查
rows.creator: z84270602
rows.risk_description:
SSD盘为耗材，存在擦写寿命达集中到期的风险，导致需要批量集中更换，而在当地无足够的备件进行更换的情况下，存在业务中断的风险，目前全球已发生多起。所以，需要发货超过4年的SSD盘进行风险排查，如满足排查条件，提前储备备件或更换。

SSDs are consumables and may be replaced in batches due to the expiration of their erasure/write lifespan. However, services may be interrupted if local spare parts are insufficient for replacement. Currently, there are many projects that are nearing the end of their lifespan in batches around the world. Therefore, SSDs that have been delivered for more than four years need to be checked for risks. If the check conditions are met, reserve spare parts or replace them in advance.

rows.title: Risk of Digital Certificate Expiration
rows.creator: f00199581
rows.risk_description:
【NE involved】
All BSC6900/6910 controller & All 2/3/4/5 G sites

[Problem Description]
A preconfigured certificate is issued by the vendor's CA and is used only to establish an initial secure channel for devices to access the customer network during deployment. According to 3GPP TS 33.310, the certificate preconfigured by the vendor must be replaced with the operator certificate before commercial use. Currently, a large number of devices on the carrier's network still use Huawei pre-configured certificates. In October 2024, the preconfigured certificates of nearly 3000 base station controllers will expire. After the certificates expire, the OMCH between the base station controllers and the U2000 will be disconnected.

【Solution】
1: Deploy operator-own CA
2. Deploy MAE LiteCA

【Guide】：http://3ms.huawei.com/km/groups/2026591/blogs/details/13748395?l=zh-cn&moduleId=732999204558016512&ctype=-1

【Risk mitigation and confirmation】
(1) Collect all wireless NE data for HQ/Romania GTAC to analyze certificate risk.
(2) Complete risk mitigation based on the customer's mitigation solution and plan (refer to the task/risk closure conditions), in the guide.
(3) Frontline engineers collect controller data on live network again and HQ analyzes the data and confirms that the controller certificate has been replaced.

rows.title: Reliability Assurance for Hardware-FDD
rows.creator: f00199581
rows.risk_description:
【NE involved】
Modules that are delivered in batches and have been put into commercial use for one to two years.
【Risk description】
Background: Under the background of supply continuity, a large number of components of FDD hardware modules have been switched since 2021, and a large number of matching software has been updated accordingly. In 2022, hardware module problems such as RRU5505 phase-locked loop, RRU5502 time sequence, and power terminal carbonization occurred. According to the problem rules, these problems are caused by the problems on the live network that have been exposed during the batch commercial use of new hardware for more than one year, and affecting the customer network a lot.

【Action】
1. Proactively check risks of new hardware modules, identify potential risks, high temperature/humidity, and power supply environment exceptions, and analyze and rectify faulty modules in advance.
2. Start and check the modules with carbonization risks of high-power power terminals, proactively identify potential sites, and clear the sites.

rows.risk_description:
check whether below risk existing in current network or not. if yes, record risk in system to follow up

[Problem Scenario]:Power terminals are carbonized and burnt at multiple sites in high-temperature countries.
[Fault Symptom]:In high-temperature areas, the power terminals of high-power modules are carbonized and burnt.
[Trigger Condition]:1. The stripped length of the power cable is insufficient.The contact resistance becomes large after the insulation layer is pressed. As a result, the power cable is overheated and burnt. 2. The power cable at the ground clip is not well-made and has no shield layer. The insulation of the cable is damaged and short-circuited with the ground clip.

[Check Method]:
1. For sites earlier than SRAN17.1SPC180, extract central-layer fault logs(section 2.4 in the guide) and inventory files(section 2.2 in the guide).
2. In SRAN17.1SPC180 and later versions, the resistance detection solution is incorporated to identify risky sites based on power supply alarm monitoring. RFTEST logs(section 2.6 in the guide) and inventory files(section 2.2 in the guide) need to be extracted to accurately identify high-risk sites.
3、Send the collected inventory files and central-layer fault logs/RFTEST logs to Zhou Cai 0051065 for data analysis.

rows.creator: c00376477
rows.risk_description:
Small networks outside China have not been inspected for a long time, leading to risks such as version EOS, non-standard configuration, no network protection, and insufficient capacity. In 2022, start the small-network risk elimination project. The datacom maintenance team of the representative office completes network preventive maintenance inspection, identifies network risks, and implements risk elimination actions. The specific tasks are as follows:
1. Create an inspection analysis task on the NetCare platform to inspect datacom devices (including routers, switches, and firewalls). Enter the inspection order number (HCXXXXXX) in this work order.
2. Record the identified risks in the NetCare system based on the inspection results, and create a risk ticket to track and close the risks.
3. Update the emergency plan, check whether the remote access mode is available, and check whether active/standby plane protection is available for core services.
If you have any questions about the risks identified during the inspection and the risk handling suggestions, contact Chen Zongrong (employee ID: 00376477).
If you need help during risk closure, submit a trouble ticket to the GTAC or contact Cuitao (employee ID: 00364480).
If the customer does not agree or thinks that the inspection is not required, upload the information confirmed with the customer when closing the work order.

rows.resolution_details: [Question reply]:Configuration on the MSAN as below.Set the SNMP parameters as below example:The user name is user1, the group name is group1,The user authentication mode is SHA, the authentication password is authkey123,The user encryption mode is aes128, the encryption password is prikey123,The read, write and notify view names are hardy, and the view includes the internet subtree.(config)#snmp-agent usm-user v3 user1 group1 authentication-mode sha authkey123 privacy-mode aes128 prikey123(config)#snmp-agent group v3 group1 privacy read-view hardy write-view hardy notify-view hardy(config)#snmp-agent mib-view hardy include internetEnable the function of sending traps.(config)#snmp-agent trap enable standardConfigure the IP address of the destination host for the traps:Assume that for example:The host name is test0001The IP address of the host is 10.10.1.10/24 (IP address of the U2000)The trap parameter name is ABCThe SNMP version is v3The parameter security name is user1 (when the SNMPv3 is used, the parameter security name is the USM user name), and the traps are authenticated and encrypted.(config)#snmp-agent target-host trap-hostname test0001 address 10.10.1.10 trap-paramsname ABC(config)#snmp-agent target-host trap-paramsname ABC v3 securityname user1 privacyConfigure the IP address of the VLAN interface as the source address for sending traps.(config)#snmp-agent trap source vlanif xxxxSet the SNMP version.(config)#snmp-agent sys-info version v3Save the data(config)#saveConfiguration on the NCE side.Open the Network Management app and choose System > NE Communication Parameters from the main menu.Then click Default Access Protocol Parameters.Then create the parameters that you have configured in the MSAN above.

rows.resolution_details: [Question reply]:Regarding the authorization mode :If several authorization modes are set for an authorization scheme, they take effect in the sequence of configuration.The next authorization mode is attempted only when the current authorization mode does not respond.If the user fails the authorization in a certain mode, the authorization of the next mode is not performed.If the current authorization mode does not respond, the system goes to the next authorization mode. If the current authorization fails or succeeds, the system does not go to next authorization mode.As confirmed with R&D, there is no risk for configuring any one first. Both are ok, and it depends on whether customer wants to use HWTACACS or local.Regarding sending syslog messages from Nodes to iNCE & the risks of it :You can do, and this has no risk. Only CPU will be a bit higher based on the frequency of sending the logs. But, generally, you can do.

Between June 20 and June 24, there was an abnormality in the power supply to SMU.Possible causes:1. The SMU was not securely installed, resulting in poor contact and affecting the power supply to the SMU. (This is a newly installed SMU.)2. The SMU hardware was faulty, resulting in abnormal power supply inside the SMU. (This is an old SMU that had been used for more than four years and was moved from another site.)3. The position where the subrack contacts the SMU was faulty, resulting in abnormal power supply to the SMU.[Problem root cause]:Possible causes:1. The SMU was not securely installed, resulting in poor contact and affecting the power supply to the SMU. (This is a newly installed SMU.)2. The SMU hardware was faulty, resulting in abnormal power supply inside the SMU. (This is an old SMU that had been used for more than four years and was moved from another site.)3. The position where the subrack contacts the SMU was faulty, resulting in abnormal power supply to the SMU.[Solution]:1. Observe the system for several days to check whether the problem recurs.2. If the problem recurs, check whether the rear of the SMU and the inside of the slot are normal. Provide photos of the rear of the SMU and the inside of the slot.3. If the problem recurs and the SMU and the slot are normal, replace the SMU with a new spare part.4. If the problem persists, replace the subrack.[Risk of Solution]:No

rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:DFW action implementation per operator[Problem analysis]:Thanks to find solution as per your required (block rule per operator) after enabled diameter firewall feature on the SPS.[Problem root cause]:So firstly we can specify operator by using realm with one operator (ADD DMFWORNSTGY) ,and specify strategy ENABLE_FIREWALL_STRATEGY.For example :ADD DMFWORNSTGY: BARNM="OrangeDMFW", RN="xxxx", STGY=ENABLE_FIREWALL_STRATEGY, FWSTGY="OrangeDMFW"; Then using DMPEER for match with Strategy group name and Realm name together identify a unique origin realm check strategy data record.And specifying Security strategy type with Enable origin-realm strategy, so we need to use ADD DMFWORNSTGY to add parameter Strategy group name before being used. This parameter specifies the name of a Diameter signaling firewall origin-realm strategy. rows.problem_summary: NC  Summer VSWR sites
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:NC Summer VSWR sites[Problem analysis]:Alarm log show that VSWR alarm are reported from RRU 80&201.The RS of RRU 80&201 is LO.The cell is 2&12 for RRU 80&201.The TxRx mode is 2T2R.The ALMPROCSW of RRU 80&201 is OFF.When ALMPROCSW is set to off and the VSWR is greater than the VSWR alarm post-processing threshold, the RF module will reduce the total transmit power of TX channels by 3 dB to avoid damage caused by high VSWR and provide as many services as possible. Different scenarios are described as follows:In the scenario where two TX channels are configured with transmit diversity and MIMO, the TX power of one channel is decreased by 3 dB if a major VSWR alarm is generated in this channel. Meanwhile, the TX power of the other channel also needs to be decreased by 3 dB for the power balance of TX channels.The log of RRU 80 is show that TX power of channel is decreased by 3 dBThe log of RRU 201 is show that TX power of channel is decreased by 3 dBThe coverage is slightly decreases when TX power of channel is decreased by 3 dBThe THP is slightly decreases when TX power of channel is decreased by 3 dBThe RAN2 is improved after alarm clearing.[Problem root cause]:The TX power of one channel is decreased by 3 dB if a major VSWR alarm is generated. The coverage and throughput is slightly deteriorate.[Solution]:The TX power of one channel is decreased by 3 dB if a major VSWR alarm is generated. The coverage and throughput is slightly deteriorate.[Risk of Solution]:no risk

rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:NC Summer VSWR sites[Problem analysis]:  The online standing wave value and the offline standing wave value of the module are both higher than the alarm threshold. This is caused by poor external feeder connections, leading to an increased standing wave value. It is recommended to conduct an on-site inspection to check the feeder connections.The TX power of one channel is decreased if a major VSWR alarm is generated. The coverage and throughput will be impacted slightly.[Problem root cause]: This is caused by poor external feeder connections, leading to an increased standing wave value. [Solution]:  It is recommended to conduct an on-site inspection to check the feeder connections. That is, check each segment between the RRU and the antenna one by one to see if there are any loose connections, improper connections, inadequate waterproofing, or faults in the connecting cables (feeder or jumper) between the RRU and the antenna, and so on.For details, see the following common causes of VSWR problems:1. The feeder connector of the antenna port is not properly made, not tightened, or has water or metal scraps.2. The feeder connected to the antenna port is squeezed or bent, or the feeder is damaged.3. The frequency band type of the RF unit does not match that of the antenna system components (such as the antenna, feeder, jumper, coupler, filter, and TMA).4. The antenna system components are damaged.[Risk of Solution]: no risks.

rows.problem_summary: BEFEEC alarm reported on 10-SDN502-2 at ALMAZA  site
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:BEFEEC alarm reported on 10-SDN502-2 at ALMAZA site[Problem analysis]:We start the troubleshooting of the problem by:STEP1:Check the alarm on the NE -> No others alarms. The existing alarms were all related with 40G board NS3.STEP2:Check the values of the Dispersion Compensation Values of the NS3 on the board.STEP3:Based on the Dispersion Compensation Values reported by the NS3, we made a simple calculation (-360/17=-21Km). We conclude that were 20km DCM compensation missing on the link.STEP4:Because we didn't know where was the problem, and because we add a team on site , we installed a DCM(A) (20km) in Aveiro HUB in each direction to compensate the missing dispersion value.[Problem root cause]:We requested OTDR and fiber type information to customer.Almost all the information was consistent but we found a problem in the path[Solution]:hat small path of G.652 fiber between sites was the responsible and the root cause for the dispersion compensation mismatch between the planning and the implementation.After the troubleshooting made by Huawei engineer, customer changed the fiber type on the path  from G.655 to G.552 (to be consistent with the rest of the network).[Risk of Solution]:NA

rows.problem_summary: ODU_SNCP_PS alarm reported on ETS Rings at  OCT2 on line board
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:ODU_SNCP_PS alarm reported on ETS Rings at OCT2 on line board[Problem analysis]:We checked the service, on which path service is running.2. In the ASON trail Management Window, the original defined path as same as actual path of the service.3. Then we check on the NE explorer-->WDM cross-connection-->SNCP service control and find out the cross-connection of line & client board4. Check the cross-connection status from the NE explorer, it shows "Protection Channel" that means service running on 39-NS3.[Problem root cause]:The details has been shared in the handlind process.The conclusion is SNCP cross-connection is not related with the ASON trail route. The thing is cross-connection created at NE 24-NS3 is working and 39-NS3 is protection cross-connection and the current channel shown is "Protection Channel" that means service is on 39-NS3 i.e. protection cross-connection of 24-NS3 that's why ODU_SNCP_PS alarm reported on slot 24-NS3.[Solution]:If we want to clear the ODU_SNCP_PS alarm then switch the path to 24-NS3 i.e. positive protection. Please find the below steps: 1. Select the ASON service.2. Check the path in actual route.3. Goto "Maintenance" and select "switch ASON trail Manually".4. After doing that, service switched to 24-NS3 i.e. protection path(defined in original route) and alarm got cleared.[Risk of Solution]:

rows.resolution_summary: After doing that, service switched to 24-NS3 i.e. protection path(defined in original route) and alarm got cleared.

rows.problem_summary: IN_pwr_HIGH reported on 22-SDN502-2 at Zamalek  site
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:IN_pwr_HIGH reported on 22-SDN502-2 at Zamalek site[Problem analysis]:1. Check that the LDX board in slot 5 of the OSN 1800 NE reports an IN_PWR_HIGH alarm on port 1 and 3.2. Check the current input power of the LDX board in slot 5 which is high, and therefore the IN_PWR_HIGH alarm is reported.3. Attempt to adjust the VOA attenuation on the OBU board on the optical layer link. It is found that the FEC value on the LDX board fluctuates significantly.4. rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]: Eth-Trunk member interfaces cannot be selected on the CE6881.[Problem analysis]:1.CE6881 is a group of M-LAG devices. The CE6881 is connected to the C firewall through an Eth-Trunk. The customer reported that the member interface of Eth-Trunk 10 on the M-LAG backup could not be selected.2.The following is the state info of Eth-Trunk 10. The fourth bit from left to right in the ActorPortName PortState field is 1, indicating that the local member interface is correctly added to the Eth-Trunk. The fourth bit from left to right in the Partner PortState field is 0, indicating that the peer member interface is not correctly added to the Eth-Trunk. the peer LACP protocol does not select their own interface. As a result, LACP negotiation fails and the Eth-Trunk goes down.3.According to the peer analysis, the reason why the Eth-Trunk member interface cannot be selected is that the system ID sent by the local end is inconsistent.4.According to the LLD, the 10GE1/0/38 and 10GE1/0/39 interfaces of the CE switch are incorrectly connected to the peer end. The physical member interfaces of the M-LAG master and backup devices are connected to different peer ends. As a result, the Eth-Trunk member interface of the M-LAG backup device cannot be selected.[Problem root cause]: Physical member interfaces of Eth-Trunk on the M-LAG master and backup devices are connected to different peer devices.[Solution]: Adjusting the Eth-Trunk member interfaces on the M-LAG master and backup devices to connect to the same peer device[Risk of Solution]: If Huawei deploy configuration change, need to raise RFC review.

rows.problem_summary: SPAN_LOSS_UPPER_GAIN and SPAN_LOSS_EXCEED_EOL reported on the optical shelf M12 at Mohandsen site
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:SPAN_LOSS_UPPER_GAIN and SPAN_LOSS_EXCEED_EOL reported on the optical shelf M12 at Mohandsen site[Problem analysis]:1- SPAN_LOSS_UPPER_GAIN alarm reported on slot 13 of Mohandsen NE . This alarm indicates that the actual span loss is larger than the power compensation value and the difference between the two exceeds the specified threshold.2-  As checked, the current span loss is 24.0dB and current nominal gain is 22.0dB. The Span Loss > Nominal Gain, and the difference is >= 2.0dB, thus SPAN_LOSS_UPPER_GAIN alarm is reported.3- The Line Attenuation Compensation default threshold is 2.0dB. . In order to prevent the alarm jitter, the alarm will be cleared only when the alarm is less than half of the threshold.The alarm will be reported when the difference is greater than 2.0dB and the alarm will only clear when the difference is less than 1.0dB.So, it is necessary to increase the gain by more than 1.0 dB for the alarm to disappear.4- Checked the OD report, the current VOA and upstream post-VOA have no adjustable margin left.Current gain value is 22.0dB, only can increase 1.0dB as the maximum is 23.0db. However, only increase 1.0dB gain may not be enough.Besides that, the output power is at its maximum. When the output is at its maximum, it is not recommended to increase the gain of the optical amplifier to avoid optical amplifier saturation.5. It is recommended to repair the fiber. Or, may replace the OA subcard with a higher gain range such as TN52OACE101.[Problem root cause]:The actual span loss is larger than the power compensation value and the difference between the two exceeds the specified threshold[Solution]:Issue resolved and alarm cleared after replace with the OA subcard TN52OACE101 which has a higher gain range.[Risk of Solution]:N/A , it was a new shelf not carry services

No alarm is reported, the optical power is normal, and the FEC attribute is always normal.2. Check whether the port settings, working mode, and service type of the T212 board are supported. Timeslot negotiation fails.Channel negotiation failure modelAfter the line mode in the direction from station B to station C is changed from the speed-up mode to the standard mode, PM bytes can be received normally.The alarm is cleared.【Root Cause】The ODU2 line rate mode is incorrectly set.【Solution】Change the speedup mode to standard mode.[Risk of Solution]:

rows.problem_summary: PORT_MODULE_OFFLINE alarm reported on new T230 board at ZAM Ring
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:PORT_MODULE_OFFLINE alarm reported on new T230 board at ZAM Ring[Problem analysis]:Based on the initial checking on NCE alarm, there was no specific alarm parameter to identify the port locationUpon checking the logs, The PORT_MODULE_OFFLINE alarm is reported at optical interface 13/14 on NE 3-5[Problem root cause]: The following figure shows the panel of the G2AST4 board.Optical ports 13 and 14 (ports HP1 and HP2 on the front panel) of the TNG2AST4 board are 1588 high-precision clock optical ports. However, the UPS does not support 1588 high-precision clocks. Therefore, the host does not create a model for ports 13 and 14 when developing the UPS and M12. That is, when the UPS is connected to the M12, the 13/14 optical port is not supported. Therefore, the 13/14 optical port is not set during initialization configuration. Therefore, the 13/14 port on the AST4 board of the NE does not report the alarm.Further analyzed the fact that optical interface 13/14 of NE did not change to the UNUSE state.[Solution]:Check if any optical module is inserted to this port. If no then make sure the port status is set to UNUSED[Risk of Solution]:

rows.problem_summary: Sapesco customer face packet drop”
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:Sapesco customer face packet drop”[Problem analysis]:According last time solution deploy, we get the conclusion that the third-part MW network had highly sensitive with burst packets. When we configure port-shaping on ATN device, the service is normal, but when we configure similar function on new PTN device, in the daytime there have packets loss again on third-part MW link.[Problem root cause]:we compared all the parameters between port-queue and user-queue. It is found below difference; the only default burst size is different.[Solution]:# flow-wred 50M  // configure queue-depth to make the device can cache more traffic.queue-depth 1250 # flow-queue 50M   // due to the interface didn’t configure QOS and all traffic forward on BE queue, just adjust BE queue-depth queue be wfq weight 10 flow-wred 50M # qos-profile 50M  // configure CBS and PBS to 5K which make the burst size nearly same with port-shaping, but because of different location, the PTN configure a little large then ATN user-queue cir 50000 cbs 5000 pir 50000 pbs 5000 flow-queue 50M // The below command already configured under eth-trunk 2.474, no need configure again#interface Eth-Trunk2.474qos-profile 50M inboundqos-profile 50M outbound#[Risk of Solution]: n/a
rows.resolution_name_map: 客户华为设备维护质量
rows.resolution_summary: configure flow-wred 50M

In order to confirm that everything is running smoothly, customer would like to get the way of: How to confirm that load sharing is actually existing? You can run this command display lacp link-aggregation summaryAnd from results you see if it load sharing yes or no like the below exampleHow to get the actual percentage of sharing for each port in the aggregation group? You can run the below command to check the percentage value display port traffic as below example In scenario where the OLT/MSAN is connected to aggregation switch, which device is controlling the load sharing traffic (inbound, outbound) and the percentage of each port in this group is calculated randomly or based on what? and the share for each port is the same for both in and out?OLT is responsible for outbound traffic not it’s inbound traffic and it use LACP hash algorithm for controlling the load sharing traffic, The OLT selects the route of the aggregation group based on the packet informationSo we can’t grantee that share for each port is same for in and out as OLT is only responsible for it’s outbound packets not inbound.Note: The algorithm of OLT cannot ensure that the traffic is balanced on each uplink port if there are some similar characteristics in SMAC/DMAC

rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:Sec Stat Dynamic Resource Over Threshold Alarm[Problem analysis]:1. Alarm is reported and cleared after nearly 30 seconds.2. Firewall defend ipcar source session-rate-limit enable is configured, which limits the rate at which connections are established for incoming packets based on a source IP address.3. Session table statistics show the number of sessions is 2.03% of the maximum value.4. All slot 1 Cpus are in normal range.5. Traffic trend is the same like everyday.6. Same for FW2.[Problem root cause]:The IPCAR table has multiple entries. Each entry records new connection information about an IP address, including the IP address, type (source or destination IP address), current new connection rate, and peak new connection rate. The specification value of the IPCAR table is 200,000 per CPU, and the default alarm threshold is 80%. If the IPCAR table does not refresh the statistical information of the new rate within the aging time, the table entry will be aged.[Solution]:By default, the aging time for entries in the IPCAR table is 60s. Change aging-time of the IPCAR table to 30 sec to avoid the alarm from reporting again.[HUAWEI] firewall defend ipcar table aging-time 30[Risk of Solution]:None

rows.resolution_details: [Question reply]:Kindly support to clarify the recommended procedure for SNMPv3 configuration deployment on Huawei NEs and NCEs. We need your confirmation regarding the following points: -SNMPv3 Configuration Deployment Method. What is the recommended procedure to enable SNMPv3 between NEs and NCEs instead of SNMPv2C ?Confirmation Steps: 1. Configuration on the MSAN as below. o Set the SNMP parameters as below example:Ø The user name is user1, the group name is group1,Ø The user authentication mode is SHA, the authentication password is authkey123,Ø The user encryption mode is aes128, the encryption password is prikey123,Ø The read, write and notify view names are hardy, and the view includes the internet subtree. o (config)#snmp-agent usm-user v3 user1 group1 authentication-mode sha authkey123 privacy-mode aes128 prikey123 o (config)#snmp-agent group v3 group1 privacy read-view hardy write-view hardy notify-view hardy o (config)#snmp-agent mib-view hardy include internetNo need for this command if the device already working now and sending traps to NCE side2. Enable the function of sending traps. o (config)#snmp-agent trap enable standard 3. Configure the IP address of the destination host for the traps: o Assume that for example:Ø The host name is test0001Ø The IP address of the host is 10.10.1.10/24 (IP address of the U2000)Ø The trap parameter name is ABCØ The SNMP version is v3Ø The parameter security name is user1 (when the SNMPv3 is used, the parameter security name is the USM user name), and the traps are authenticated and encrypted.No need for this command if the device already working now and sending traps to NCE sideo (config)#snmp-agent target-host trap-hostname test0001 address 10.10.1.10 trap-paramsname ABC o (config)#snmp-agent target-host trap-paramsname ABC v3 securityname user1 privacyNo need for this step also if the device already working now and sending traps to NCE side4. Configure the IP address of the VLAN interface as the source address for sending traps. o (config)#snmp-agent trap source vlanif 942 5. Set the SNMP version.This should be all not V3 only as if you change it to V3 and device currently working in V2C the device will be offline at NCE o (config)#snmp-agent sys-info version v3First configure it as below:(config)#snmp-agent sys-info version all  6. Save the data o (config)#save 7. Configuration on the NCE side. o Open the Network Management app and choose System > NE Communication Parameters from the main menu. o Then click Default Access Protocol Parameters. o Then create the parameters that you have configured in the MSAN above. -Batch Deployment Can this configuration be deployed in batch through NCE? If yes, kindly share the recommended script format or template.yes, kindly find the script we test together in attached  -Verification After Deployment Kindly confirm the required commands or steps to verify that SNMPv3 configuration has been applied successfully on the OLT. For example, we need to confirm: SNMPv3 user is created successfully.(config)#display snmp-agent usm-user SNMP agent/service is enabled.(config)#display snmp-agent sys-info version Trap target/NMS IP is configured correctly.(config)#display snmp-agent target-host SNMPv3 packets are sent from the OLT to the NMS.(config)#display snmp-agent statistics The NMS can successfully poll the OLT using SNMPv3.Yes, it can. SNMP traps are received successfully on the NMS side.The traps are viewed on time after receiving by NMS, you can check them from the alarm and event logs pages  -Connectivity Test Kindly share the recommended test method to confirm that the SNMPv3 connection between the OLT and NMS is working properly. We need to know: Which commands should be used from the OLT side?no need  Which checks should be done from the NMS side? just use the connectivity check How can we confirm that authentication and encryption are working correctly?by testing the SNMP protocol from th

Like a small telephone exchange inside a building.MSAN >> Multi Service Access Node (a public network access device). Brings phone/internet to many homes/buildings.Located in the street cabinet.Ex. Installed by the telephone company at the street level.MSAN can’t work as PBX.PBX FeatureMSAN Can do route calls between office extensions  Not designed for internal call routingSet up call transfers, hold, conferenceHas no business call featuresCan manage company phone numbersOnly provides access, not switchingMSAN can connect to PBX as the MSAN acts as a bridge between the telecom network and the PBX.To clarify it better think of MSAN as a water pipe that brings water to the buildings. Think of PBX as the water heater inside a building.The pipe (MSAN) delivers water to the building, but it cannot heat the water or distribute it to different rooms and that's what the building's plumbing (PBX) does.In conclusion MSAN is fundamentally an access device, not a switching device. It was never designed to replace PBX functionality.MSAN = Access Device (connects users to the network)PBX = Switching Device (routes calls internally)They serve completely different purposes. No configuration can change MSAN into a PBX.
rows.resolution_summary: confirmed that MSAN is fundamentally an access device, not a switching device. It was never designed to replace PBX functionality and no configuration can change MSAN into a PBX.

rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]: users in the event noticed they spent long time on 3G[Problem analysis]:1.1 Configuration Check:No abnormalities were found in the basic configuration of MM. 1.2 KPI Check:1. During high traffic periods, the RRC connection setup success rate of MM deteriorated significantly, with the L1.8 cell being more severely affected. 2. The deterioration trend of the e-RAB setup success rate is the same as that of the RRC setup success rate. 3. Compared to 2T cells, MM cells have higher loads and more users during high traffic periods.  4. Compared to 2T cells, MM cells have 6dB higher uplink interference. However, the MCS and CQI are both better than those in 2T cells.   5. By analyzing the causes of RRC call drops, it was found that the main cause of call drops is L.RRC.SetupFail.Noreply. rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:       It is reported that PING packets loss from switch to PS server, need check the reason and give solution.[Problem analysis]:The topology as bellow1.Checked the MAC(e84d-7429-de91) of PS server, it is found that it learned from 10GE1/0/37 and the port usage reached 100%.2.Further checked the bandwidth usage on C1-HQ-Outgoing-LSW1/ C1-HQ-Outgoing-LSW2/ SOC-SWI09. Some ports are 100% usage. And from the MAC flapping record, it is found that the MAC learn in VLAN 111. And all these ports pass VLAN 111.3.Continue to check the topology, it is found that there is a loop between C1-HQ-Outgoing-LSW1/ C1-HQ-Outgoing-LSW2/ SOC-SWI09 as bellow. When a broadcast traffic or unknown unicast packets send to VLAN 111. It will be broadcast to all the ports that allow VLAN 111. Due to the loop, the packet is continuously broadcast, and finally occupies the bandwidth of all the ports that allow VLAN 111.4.Checked the port connection, both physical port 10GE1/0/45 on LSWs connected to same Stack switch, we can shutdown the 10GE1/0/45 on LSW1 to break the loop as workaround. rows.problem_summary: when inputting more than 15 commands, CLI is interrupted and an error appears
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:Customer reported that when they copy and paste the attached commands (more than 1000 lines), the command-line get stuck and the rest commands not running[Problem analysis]:During the checking, if we manually run only this unique command line, it would work. This means the command line had no issue.By confirming the version of the MA5600T, it was MA5600V800R018C10SPC238.By checking in the lab for MA5600T, even for higher version of MA5600T, it will stuck at the same point of commandsPlease notice the version we tested in the lab is even higher than in the real networkBy testing the MA5800, MA5800 could finish all the commands.[Problem root cause]:One point is clear: When customer copy many commands and pastes, all the commands are stored inside buffer. Then the commands are picked out one by one from buffer and run.MA5600T has one relatively smaller buffer than the MA5800 devices, in this case, no matter what kind of commands and no matter using SSH/telnet and no matter using what kind of method to run the commands, the buffer size is unique.When customer uses copy and paste method, each command line acts as one independent segment inside the buffer and consumes the buffer. The buffer has limit, so that the command lines could be executed is unique.Customer saw the command line stuck is actually because that command is the end of the buffer and all other commands could not be shown, actually did not enter the buffer. They were dropped and could not be run.For ONT add commands, no more than 216 commands can be copy and pasted into buffer in a roll.However, please notice different commands will consume different buffer. (for example, we can copy and paste 216 “ont add”commands, but it does not mean we can we can copy and paste more than 200 “service-port” add commands).[Solution]:Make commands into scripts, and perform load scripts to the device. Then those commands will not be inside buffer, but will be loaded into MA5600T execution queue as a whole.Command method: login device locally and perform “ load script ftp xxx 123.txt”NCE method: Please check the attached guide[Risk of Solution]: NA

rows.problem_summary: The impact in case of using aunified LAC/TAC mapping for National roaming (NR) sites over the RNC/BSCandif this solution is recommended or not?
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:The impact in case of using aunified LAC/TAC mapping for National roaming (NR) sites over the RNC/BSCandif this solution is recommended or not?[Problem analysis]:1. The paging channel has a great impact. Therefore, the paging combination scheme must be submitted to the ITMO for review in advance to avoid paging congestion. 2. rows.problem_summary: LOFLOM alarm reported at POP9 site
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:LOFLOM alarm reported at POP9 site【Problem Description】The V6G216 board reported an ODU1_LOFLOM alarm.【Handling Process】1. The alarm indicates that the ODU1:1 timeslot is not configured with a corresponding WDM cross-connect.2. Checking the corresponding timeslot board, it was found that the corresponding timeslot was configured with an SDH virtual port, but the other end was not configured with the relevant configuration, resulting in frame signal loss and an alarm report.【Root Cause】The board is configured with an SDH virtual port, but the peer has not configured the corresponding port.【Solution】It works normally after deleting the SDH virtual port configuration.【Suggestion and Summary】physical port is set to ODU2. If the local end is configured with a service but the remote end is not, an ODU2_PM_OCI alarm will be reported. If a low-level ODU1 or ODU0 service is configured on the port, the OCI alarm will end. If a low-level service is configured on the local end but the remote end is not, the local end will report the corresponding ODUk_LOFLOM alarm.

rows.problem_summary: ODU_SNCP_PS alarm reported on line board at Shobra site
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:ODU_SNCP_PS alarm reported on line board at Shobra site[Problem analysis]:ODU_SNCP_PS alarm reported even original and actual route of service are same. Customer has raised one query that ASON service shows "No Alarm" but when we select the service and click alarm window, then shows "ODU_SNCP_PS" alarm reported. We can take an example of one ASON service of Bharti 40G Network i.e. diamond ASON: 1. Trail shows No Alarm:  2. ODU_SNCP_PS alarm reported when we select service and click alarm: 【Handling Process】1. We checked the service, on which path service is running.2. In the ASON trail Management Window, the original defined path as same as actual path of the service.3. Then we check on the NE explorer-->WDM cross-connection-->SNCP service control and find out the cross-connection of line & client board  The above scenario in the network. 4. Check the cross-connection status from the NE explorer, it shows "Protection Channel" that means service running on 39-NS3.   That means service running on Slot-39-NS3 and the same route shown in ASON trail window.Then the question comes why ODU_SNCP_PS reported[Problem root cause]:The details has been shared in the handlind process.The conclusion is SNCP cross-connection is not related with the ASON trail route. The thing is cross-connection created at NE 24-NS3 is working and 39-NS3 is protection cross-connection and the current channel shown is "Protection Channel" that means service is on 39-NS3 i.e. protection cross-connection of 24-NS3 that's why ODU_SNCP_PS alarm reported on slot 24-NS3. And the trail showing "No Alarm" and ODU_SNCP_PS reported on the node.[Solution]:If we want to clear the ODU_SNCP_PS alarm then switch the path to 24-NS3 i.e. positive protection. Please find the below steps: 1. Select the ASON service.2. Check the path in actual route.3. Goto "Maintenance" and select "switch ASON trail Manually".4. After doing that, service switched to 24-NS3 i.e. protection path(defined in original route) and alarm got cleared.[Risk of Solution]:

rows.problem_summary: BD_STATUS alarm reported on new board N502 at Shobra site
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:BD_STATUS alarm reported on new board N502 at Shobra site[Problem analysis]:. Replaced the CQ1 board. The alarm persisted. After the customer cold reset the PEG8 board, the alarm was cleared.2. Checked the history alarms of the PEG board. The BUS_ERR alarm was reported at the same time as the BD_STATUS alarm reported by the CQ1 board. This alarm indicates that the communication between the PEG board and the CQ1 board on the interface board was abnormal.3. Checked the logs of the PEG board and found that the 8850 chip was abnormal. As a result, the communication between the PEG board and the CQ1 board was abnormal. As a result, the PEG board mistakenly detected that the interface board was offline and reported the BD_STATUS alarm.[Problem root cause]:The PEG8 hardware on the service processing board is faulty. As a result, the communication between the service processing board and the interface board is abnormal. As a result, the board incorrectly detects that the interface board is offline and reports the BD_STATUS alarm.[Solution]:Replacing the  board[Risk of Solution]:

rows.problem_summary: IPPM Activation Drawbacks Technical Query
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:IPPM Activation Drawbacks Technical Query[Problem analysis]:What is the impact when activate IPPM over all Etisalat BSS Network.The impact of IPPM In general that With IP PM, FM and BR frames are periodically sent and received between the IP PM initiator and responder. This occupies extra transmission bandwidth and increases the overhead. For example, an extra 6 kbit/s bandwidth is occupied for an IP PM session when the measurement period is 100 ms.Also there is a special requirements for CN that it must be provided by Huawei What is the benefits of IPPM Activation.Monitoring network performance in real time:IP PM monitors network performance in real time and provides statistics of transmission counters. This helps operators quickly identify transmission faults and take effective measures, such as expanding network capacity or optimizing the transport network.Locating the transmission fault quicklyIP PM helps quickly locate transmission performance-related problems (such as an overly high packet loss rate and long delay) and isolate the faults, thereby improving network maintainability and reducing O&M cost.Reporting an alarm once the predefined packet loss rate threshold is exceededWith IP PM, the NE reports an alarm upon detecting that the realtime packet loss rate has exceeded a predefined threshold. This helps operators take rectifying measures in a timely manner.When should we avoid enabling IPPM.In IUB interface , in case Ethernet link aggregation groups work in load sharing mode on the RNC side or Ethernet ports work in route-based load sharing mode on the RNC side, IPPM will not be supported IPPM sessions has hardware capacity limitations as shown below , if it is exceeded activation will failNeed to make sure that CN is provided by HuaweiEnsure DSCP remains static across all transmission equipment otherwise IPPM will failHow accurate are IPPM measurements (latency, jitter, packet loss) compared to other tools.IPPM is more accurate than other tools as it works on real-time service packets sent and received , For Delay :  Uses Forward Monitoring (FM) and Backward Reporting (BR) frames to capture one-way and round-trip time (RTT) delaysFor Jitter: Computes standard deviation of inter-arrival time variations for forward and backward directionsFor packet loss: Compares transmitted (VS.IPPM.Local.TxPkts) and received (VS.IPPM.Peer.RxPkts) packet counts 5. Is there any other KPI that can replace IPPM and provide similar functionality TWAMP feature has same functionality as IPPMIs a specific DSCP value assigned for each activated IPPM session?Yes need to configure DSCP Value for IPPM sessions through IPPMSESSION.IPPMDSCP command , It is recommended that this parameter be set to the DSCP values of common service types.Does IPPM activation have any impact on CPU load for each node (Site & RNC)?Impact of IPPM on CPU Load on Both nodes is less.Regarding replacing IPPM with TWAMP: Does this mean TWAMP should be activated for 3G from both the RAN side and the router side?Since TWAMP is already configured on 4G sites, can the same configuration be reused for 3G, or will new TWAMP sessions need to be created?Yes configuration can be re-used but there is some parameters need to be verified as Local IP & Peer IP addresses.As I understand from your recommendation, the TWAMP session for 3G would be established between the Site and the Router only. In this case, it would not cover the complete path toward the RNC.i.    Therefore, would we need to create separate TWAMP sessions for:Site → RouterRouter → RNCii.    Please confirm if my understanding is correct.TWAMP can be implemented on connections between a GSM/UMTS dual-mode base station and a base station controller, between base station controllers, between a base station controller and a CN device, between an NE in a radio network and a transmission device (for example, a router). So it can cover the complete path toward The RNC
