According to attached SR we upgraded the OSN9800 U16 nodes to clear the HARD_ERR flapping alarm this was for two times before now for third time the nodes RP & TM & NC still flapping HARD_ERR.
Need investigation of this issue repetition, wh
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:According to attached SR we upgraded the OSN9800 U16 nodes to clear the HARD_ERR flapping alarm this was for two times before now for third time the nodes RP & TM & NC still flapping HARD_ERR. Need investigation of this issue repetition, wh[Problem analysis]:1. Analyzed the historical alarms of the NE. Four U402 boards in slots 1, 2, 10, and 11 reported the HARD_ERR alarms. The parameters were FaultChip=51 and FaultType=71, indicating that a packet check error occurred in the traffic buffer management module of the service chip.① Historical alarm② The following log records indicate that the internal packet check of the traffic cache management module is abnormal (IBTM: internal buffer traffic manager).2. The NE version upgraded from V100R006 to V100R019C10SPCa00 on April 17, 2025.3. From May to May 29, 2025, a cold reset was performed on the four U402 boards that reported the HARD_ERR alarm.4. From May to May 31, 2025, the U402 continued to transiently report the HARD_ERR alarm. The parameters were FaultChip=51 and FaultType=71.5. The HARD_ERR alarm indicates that a packet check error occurs on the traffic buffer management module (IBTM) of the service chip (FRAMER). The following figure shows the alarm detection principle. The U402 board in slot 1 is used as an example.① The U402 board in slot 1 and packet boards in different slots exchange ECM protocol packets for message sharing between packet boards.② After the service chip in slot 1 receives the ECM protocol packets from each slot, the service chip in slot 1 verifies the packets in the IBTM buffer module. If the packet verification is incorrect, the HARD_ERR alarm is reported, indicating that the packet is abnormal. Therefore, the HARD_ERR alarm is also related to the IBTM buffer module in other slots.③ In an earlier version, the packet processing mechanism of the IBTM module on the service chip used by the U402 board has a defect. As a result, there is a low probability that the received and transmitted ECM protocol packets fail to be verified, causing the HARD_ERR alarm to be transiently reported. In V100R019C10SPCa00SPHa10, the scenario where the U402 and U402 boards exchange ECM protocol packets is fixed. However, the problem takes effect only after all U402 boards on the NE are cold reset. In addition, the problem that the U402 and other packet boards exchange ECM protocol packets will be solved in V100R019C10SPCa00SPHa20Backplane interconnection scenarioSolution VersionEffective meansRelease timeU402U402R19C10SPCa00SPHa10Perform a cold reset on all U402 boards on the NE.2024.04U402 and other packet boardsR19C10SPCa00SPHa20You need to perform a cold reset only on the U402 board that reports the alarm.3.2 Troubleshooting Suggestions on the Live Network1. Perform a cold reset on the U402 boards in slots 12 and 13 on the NE to ensure that ECM protocol packets are transmitted between U402 boards and U402 boards.2. If the HARD_ERR alarm persists after the preceding operations are complete, the scenario where the U402 board and other packet boards on the NE exchange ECM protocol packets needs to be rectified. The problem will be solved in the R19C10SPCa00SPHa20 hot patch.[Problem root cause]:The packet processing mechanism of the IBTM module on the service chip used by the U402 board has a defect. As a result, there is a low probability that the received and transmitted ECM protocol packets fail to be verified, causing the HARD_ERR alarm to be transiently reported[Solution]:1. Perform a cold reset on the U402 boards in slots 12 and 13 on the NE to ensure that the ECM protocol packets between U402 boards and U402 boards are transmitted.2. If the HARD_ERR alarm persists after the preceding operations are complete, the scenario where the U402 board and other packet boards on the NE exchange ECM protocol packets needs to be rectified. This problem will be solved in the R19C10SPCa00SPHa20 hot patch.Note: mandatory to cold reset all U402 af
rows.resolution_summary: The packet processing mechanism of the IBTM module on the service chip used by the U402 board has a defect. As a result, there is a low probability that the received and transmitted ECM protocol packets fail to be verified,

rows.problem_summary: BSC6900 GSM ZBH04 CPU Load reach Maximum and wrong command result
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:BSC6900 GSM ZBH04 CPU Load reach Maximum and wrong command result[Problem analysis]:CPU Load AnalysisAccording to the CPU Usage analysis，On May 10, 2026, the average CPU usage of the OMU board reached 100% after rehoming 2 sites. The CPU usage automatically recovered in the early morning of May 11, 2026.Alarm log AnalysisAccording to the alarm log analysis，there is no any alarm can impact OMU CPU load.Configration AnalysisAccording to the CFGMML analysis,STBYOMUEXPCFGSW is ON.Whether to use the standby OMU to export configuration data when OMUs work in active/standby mode. If this parameter is set to ON, the standby OMU is used to export configuration data. If this parameter is set to OFF, the active OMU is used to export configuration data. Setting this parameter to ON reduces the consumption of the active OMU system resources and increases the efficiency of exporting configuration data. When an OMU works in independent mode, the OMU is used to export configuration data, regardless of whether this parameter is set to ON or OFF.SET OMUPARA: AutoStartFMASW is also ON, which will inpact OMU CPU load.Operation log AnalysisAccording to the operation log analysis，there is many EXP CFGSYNFILE command from MAE side, which will make OMU CPU load high .Other operation not impact OMU load.According to the operation logs, the EXP CFGSYNFILE command was executed repeatedly and timed out each time. The command is used to export all the BSC configuration data, which consumes a large number of CPU resources. As a result, the CPU usage reached 100%.OMU log AnalysisAccording to the OMU log analysis. The main processes affecting OMU usage are cfg_exp and configure processes.The sum of the usage rates of the cfg_exp process and the configure process is more than 85%, indicating that the high CPU usage rate issue is caused by the OMU exporting configurations.According to the operation logs, when the OMU CPU usage reached 100%, a large number of EXP CFGSYNFILE commands were being executed and all of them timed out, which indicates that the CPU usage reached 100% due to the BSC was executing the EXP CFGSYNFILE command.To reduces the consumption of the active OMU system resources and increases the efficiency of exporting configuration data, the system obtains the configuration from the standby OMU by default.When standby OMU faulty，the EXP CFGSYNFILE command can implement on active OMU.To ensure that the cfg_mirror process on the OMU board works properly, the system resets the cfg_mirror process on the OMU board at about 04:20 every day to reclaim resources. On May 11, the EXP CFGSYNFILE command failed to be executed twice during the reset. The system considered that the cfg_mirror process on the standby OMU board was abnormal and therefore did not execute the EXP CFGSYNFILE command on the standby OMU board. Instead, the system temporarily executed the EXP CFGSYNFILE command on the active OMU board. One day later, the system automatically executed the EXP CFGSYNFILE command on the standby OMU board.A large number of EXP CFGSYNFILE commands are executed on the active OMU.[Problem root cause]:The EXP CFGSYNFILE command fails to be executed when the cfg_mirror process of the standby OMU board is being reset. As a result, the system determines that the cfg_mirror process of the standby OMU board is abnormal. The system then executes the EXP CFGSYNFILE command on the active OMU board. MAE always send the EXP CFGSYNFILE, the EXP CFGSYNFILE command was executed repeatedly and timed out each time. The command is used to export all the BSC configuration data, which consumes a large number of CPU resources. As a result, the CPU usage reached 100%.[Solution]:The EXP CFGSYNFILE command fails to be executed when the cfg_mirror process of the standby OMU board is being reset. As a result, the system determines that the cfg_mirror process of the standby OMU board is abnormal. The system then executes the EXP CFGSYNFILE command on the acti

rows.problem_summary: Evaluate Integration of Third-Party Devices Through SMU – Smart Power Meter Pilot
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:Evaluate Integration of Third-Party Devices Through SMU – Smart Power Meter Pilot[Problem analysis]: 1. The NetEco communicates with other devices through the SSC or SMU. Therefore, the NetEco cannot directly communicate with third-party devices that are not SSCs or SMUs. If you want other third-party devices to communicate with NetEco, you must connect hird-party devices to the SSC or SMU first.2. The SMU doesn't support connecting third-party devices using the Modbus protocol.3. If you want to connect a third-party device Power Meter, please use SSC.4. If a third-party device needs to be directly connected to the NetEco through Modbus, the NetEco needs to develop an adaptation software package to implement the mapping between the Modbus signals of the third-party device and the NetEco. Currently, the NetEco cannot directly connect to the third-party device. If the customer has such a requirement, submit an RM ticket to the HQ.[Problem root cause]: The SUM has only one Modbus port, which is used to connect to the NetEco. Therefore, the third party devices can't connect to SMU with ModBus.[Solution]: 1. you can select SCC, SCC can connect the third party devices with ModBus.2. If a third-party device needs to be directly connected to the NetEco through Modbus, the NetEco needs to develop an adaptation software package to implement the mapping between the Modbus signals of the third-party device and the NetEco. Currently, the NetEco cannot directly connect to the third-party device. If the customer has such a requirement, submit an RM ticket to the HQ.[Risk of Solution]: no risk

Then if this UGW is allocated to the user, eNB static ERAB failure with TNL reason with counter L.E-RAB.FailEst.TNL(2) When GTPU static switch disenable（STATICCHK=DISABLE）For every path of S1-U from eNB to UGW,enodeb will not detect the path from eNB to UGW. except the UGW is allocated to the access user, and then eNB sends GTPU Request to this UGW every 5s. if it has continue 3 times not receiving GTPU Response from UGW, eNB will mark the path as fault and release all the call on this path and static as call drop with TNL as counter L.E-RAB.AbnormRel.TNLFor example: site LUPP3994It has 6 S1-C of s1 link to MME:It has 37 S1-U of path to UGW:Below is one case:ERAB failure with TNL:UGW IP: 10.94.105.183ERAB Drop with TNL:UGW IP: 10.94.105.184[Problem root cause]:ERAB failure with TNL reason.[Solution]:ERAB failure with TNL reason , advise to check the TX.[Risk of Solution]:NO.

rows.problem_summary: RE: RTN6900 MMPTa control card issue .
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:RTN 6900 installed and its MMPTa control card not appear in the layout and has below alarms as below.[Problem analysis]:1. From the active alarms we found COMMUN_FAIL alarm.DescriptionThe COMMUN_FAIL alarm indicates the inter-board communication failure. This alarm is reported when the communication between the system control board and other boards is interrupted.2. The possible causes of the alarms reported by the MMPTa/MMPTb/MMPTc/MMPLb board are as follows:The board is in poor contact with the backplane.The board is faulty.The slot is faulty.3. Procedure For the MMPTa/MMPTb/MMPTc/MMPLb board, handle the alarm as follows:The board is in poor contact with the backplane.Remove and re-install the alarm-reporting board. Then, check whether the alarm is clearedThe board is faulty.Replace this CTRL boardThe slot is faultyReplace the backplane after checking if any abnormal (the slot becomes faulty due to the broken pin or bent pin. Remove the board, and use a torch to observe whether there is any broken pin or bent pin.)Also we have BUS_ERR with parameter ;0x7 0x4; & ;0x30 0x3 0x1; both indicate there is abnormal between the main and standby CTRL board (A fault occurs on the overhead signals (on the third channel) transmitted between the active and standby system control boards.)[Problem root cause]:The COMMUN_FAIL alarm indicates inter-board communication failure. Possible causes include poor contact with the backplane, faulty board, or faulty slot. BUS_ERR parameters indicate abnormal communication between main and standby CTRL boards.[Solution]:1. Remove and re-install the alarm-reporting board. Then, check whether the alarm is cleared2. If not cleared after first step then Replace this CTRL board3. If alarm not cleared Replace the backplane[Risk of Solution]:None.
rows.resolution_name_map: 客户华为设备维护质量

rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:systemized the fiber inside the it rack[Problem analysis]:The Huawei standard signal cable installation route for FusionModule2000 is from the rear/backside of each rack (shown in blue), with power cables in the front side of the rack (in red). Power cables are rarely moved after installation, while IT devices are frequently deployed and maintained. Therefore, power cables are typically on the inside and signal cables are on the outside.For equipment that has front-facing signal cable ports, signal cables are routed from the back to the front as shown in the following diagram:In case it is required for signal cables to use the front holes directly on top of the cabinet, the standard is for the operator to be on top of the rack to be able to reach the front penetration holes, while maintaining safety regulations and using the appropriate PPE.A work-around for the same case is to open skylight panels: If the cable must be routed through the aisle, it is recommended to open the skylight and remove the limit plate (fixed by two screws on each side) and turn the glass to the vertical state of 90° (slowly rotate the glass by hand).The glass type is safety tempered glass. It is stronger than regular glass, however there is still some risk with cracking if it bumps against edges or corners. Therefore, extra care is needed during manual operation of skylight.[Problem root cause]:the current condition cannot use standard installation due to the room space limitation.[Solution]:R&D already provide the standard installation and workaround installation.[Risk of Solution]:no risks

rows.problem_summary: Missing tabs in DV
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:Many tabs were missing from the VAS Cloud maintenance interface on DV.[Problem analysis]:1. Based on the logs, we confirmed that an unexpected 'freeze 2-node cluster' action occurred on 2026-04-28. We noted that an upgrade of some VMS products was performed on this date, however, according to the information received, neither MTserver nor DV nodes were involved in this upgrade. Therefore, this upgrade operation should theoretically not be related to the current issue. Nevertheless, we have not yet identified the source of this unexpected ' freeze 2-node cluster' action after cross-checking with related teams.2. According to the logs from the MTserver nodes, at approximately 2026-05-16 20:58:47, one of the MTserver nodes entered slave state, which caused both nodes to transition into standby mode and led to the MTserver disconnection. Further analysis indicates that the reason for the node entering slave state was the loss of the floating IP. rows.problem_summary: Fast SCG Addition for NSA DC UEs in LTE and NR Co-Site Co-Coverage.
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:Fast SCG Addition for NSA DC UEs in LTE and NR Co-Site Co-Coverage.[Problem analysis]: 1.1 The addition success rate deteriorates.At 3:00 AM on May 18, the addition success rate deteriorated.Reviewing the operation, blind addition was enabled at 3:00 PM, which coincides with the time of deterioration.Reviewing the CHR, most of the failures are due to the terminal not responding with a reconfiguration complete message.There are top terminals.Reviewing, it is an iPhone 16 Pro Max.After adding to the blacklist yesterday, the addition success rate has not recovered. Reviewing the failed terminals, they are all iPhone 15/16 Pro Max. that because the blacklist can only ban one soft version of the iphone, however, it seems all Iphone 15/16 PM has that issue. Indeed, blind addition was performed (RSRP = -30 (from the massage, RSRP 126-156=-30)).By examining the signaling, we compared two instances of blind addition performed by the same terminal. One instance was successful, while the other failed. Upon comparing their reconfiguration messages, there were no differences. This leads to the suspicion that the terminal's abnormal behavior caused the issue.1.2 There was no significant change in traffic.After enabling blind addition, although the number of RRC users in the cell increased, the average number of activated users in the cell (the number of users performing services) did not change. Therefore, there would be no significant change in traffic.[Problem root cause]:  The iPhone 15/16 series exhibits abnormalities under blind addition. Similar cases where blind addition causes abnormal iPhone access:https://support.huawei.com/carrier/docview?nid=KB1100618093https://3ms.huawei.com/km/groups/3950992/blogs/details/21279301The number of activated users in the cell has not changed, so the traffic will not change either.Enabling blind addition does not increase traffic as expected. It only allows for faster addition of NR and does not absorb more users.[Solution]: 1. If want to find the root cause about why Iphone 15/16 PM is abnormal under blind addition, please coordinate with the terminal side to confirm the cause of the reestablish.2. Disable NSA blind addition:MOD NSADCMGMTCONFIG: LocalCellId=xx, NsaDcAlgoSwitch=NSA_BLIND_SCG_ADDITION_SWITCH-0;And rollback the blacklist.[Risk of Solution]: NA

rows.problem_summary: Dorado Vulnerabilitiies
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:Dorado Vulnerabilitiies[Problem analysis]:Analysis of CVE Vulnerabilities in Centralized Storagehttps://3ms.huawei.com/km/blogs/details/22254020[Problem root cause]:Vulnerabilities scan in Centralized Storage[Solution]:1CVE-2026-35385This does not involve the entire range of flash memory storage.Vulnerability Analysis: The vulnerability is triggered when downloading a file via scp as root. The -O parameter must be added to force the use of the older SCP protocol. Without the -p parameter (which prevents the preservation of the file's original timestamps, permissions, and other attributes), the storage system cannot be accessed by the root user. Furthermore, the storage system is a closed system and cannot execute commands such as scp; therefore, this vulnerability is not considered a vulnerability.All flash storage series are not involved. Vulnerability analysis: The vulnerability is triggered when a user downloads files as the root user through SCP. The -O parameter must be added to forcibly use the old SCP protocol, and the -p parameter is not used (that is, the original attributes such as the timestamp and permission of the file are not retained). In addition, the storage system cannot be logged in to as the root user. Furthermore, the storage system is a closed system and cannot execute commands such as scp. Therefore, this vulnerability is not involved.2CVE-2026-35386This does not involve the entire range of flash memory storage.Vulnerability Analysis: The vulnerability is triggered when the OpenSSH version is lower than 10.3 and the ProxyCommand, LocalCommand, and other commands configured in the ssh_config file use tokens such as %u (username), %h (hostname), and %r (remote username). Since the storage is not configured with these tokens in the ssh_config file, it is not affected.All series of flash storage are not involved. Vulnerability analysis: This vulnerability is triggered when the OpenSSH version is earlier than 10.3 and the ProxyCommand and LocalCommand commands configured in the ssh_config file use tokens such as %u (user name), %h (host name), and %r (remote user name). However, the storage system does not use the preceding tokens in the ssh_config file. Therefore, this vulnerability is not involved.3CVE-2026-35387This does not involve the entire range of flash memory storage.Vulnerability Analysis: The vulnerability is triggered when the OpenSSH version is lower than 10.3 and any ECDSA algorithm is listed in either the PublicKeyAcceptedAlgorithms or HostbasedAcceptedAlgorithms configuration. rows.problem_summary: Infra action to power off mentioned VMs
rows.resolution_details: 1- Run this command on VNFP "DSP VM", ensure all VMs Status are normal             don't operate on any VM unless its status is normal. 2- Power Off the VMs One by One through the following command on VNFP "POF VM:VMNAME="vm_agent1";" The timeout period for this command is 120s. The POF VM command is a synchronization command. After you run this command, a reply message is returned only after the MANO performs a series of resource clearing operations. The processing period may be longer than 120s. If the processing period is longer than 120s, a message is displayed indicating a command timeout. In this case, it is difficult to determine whether the VM has been successfully powered off. To determine this point, run the DSP VM command. 3- after the infrastructure team finishes the action on the Host, you can Power on the VMs through the following command on the VNFP "PON VM:VMNAME="vm_agent1";"while powering on the VMs, you must power on ONE BY ONE. 4- Run this command again on VNFP "DSP VM", ensure all VMs Status are normal  Caution:Never Power Off on the Master OMU  1- Perform the following command on the VNFP: DSP OMU, ensure that switch state is Ready. don't perform the action below unless the state is Ready1- Power Off the Slave OMU2, let the infrastructure team finishes their action on the host2- Power On the Slave OM23- Swap between Master OMU1 and Slave OMU2 “SWP OMU” and then DSP OMU again to ensure that the swap is done successfully4- Power Off the OMU1, let the infrastructure team finishes their action on the host5- Swap between Master and Slave OMU again to restore as it was before the action, and then DSP OMU again to ensure that the swap is done successfully You can operate on VMs under the same host all together, but you must operate Host by Host

rows.problem_summary: Critical capacity issue on oceanStor Dorado 8000 V6
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:Critical capacity issue on oceanStor Dorado 8000 V6, storage pool capacity reached 90%.[Problem analysis]:1. An alarm was triggered on the storage system on 19-05-2026 and again on 20-05-2026, indicating that the storage pool capacity had reached 90%. However, this is the first occurrence of such an alert.2. The performance logs were reviewed to identify the host generating the highest write bandwidth during the affected period. Based on the analysis, a specific host was observed generating periodic high write bandwidth, which may have contributed to the storage pool capacity increase, however there’s other parameters can also contribute, but in this case we are checking the highest host in write bandwidth3. After reviewing the services running on this storage through vCenter, it was observed that the Seibel cluster is the highest-consuming cluster in terms of resource utilization.[Problem root cause]:The storage pool capacity reached 90% due to a specific host generating periodic high write bandwidth, and the Seibel cluster is the highest-consuming cluster in terms of resource utilization.[Solution]:It is recommended that the application team review the application activities, scheduled jobs, backup operations, or any abnormal write-intensive processes related to the Seibel cluster during the reported timeframe. Additionally, continuous monitoring and housekeeping activities are recommended to prevent the storage pool utilization from reaching the threshold again.[Risk of Solution]:if storage pool capacity reached to 100 percent there will be service impact.

At most, they have received 10k BGP routes from a single neighbor.[Problem root cause]:If the number of these routes is not expected to increase significantly in the future, this risk can be ignored. but if new services are integrated in the future, it may lead to a significant increase in the number of routes. Therefore, it is recommended to carry out rectifications in accordance with the suggestions provided in the risk notice.[Solution]:According to the current status of the equipment, A maximum of 10,000 routes were received from one neighbor, and the device's memory is 16GB. It is recommended that ignore this risk. Check what is the "Rated Power" setting, and whether it is the same as the actual power of the genset on site? If this parameter is set too low, lower that actual power, the system will limit the rectifier output, causing the battery cannot be charged quickly, and result in long time genset running.[Problem root cause]: "Rated Power" setting and "Max Power Ratio" was set too low, lower that actual power, the system limit the rectifier output, causing the battery cannot be charged quickly, and result in long time genset running.[Solution]:Change the genset "Rated Power" setting and "Max Power Ratio" setting. Due to technical reasons, the 24B version must be upgraded using the integrated package. In 24B, the BSP and APP software packages must be upgraded together. For details, see the upgrade guide. 7. rows.problem_summary: Handover SR degradation (FC-9 Call Control) over KBX40
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:Handover SR degradation (FC-9 Call Control) over KBX40[Problem analysis]:for CV 9 call control failure the reason is During an inter-MSC handover, the local MSC receives an abnormal release message from the peer MSC after sending a Map_Prepare_Handover_Rsp message to the peer MSC.  From the CHR ,there are 8 time call control failure, most are because YHS16 received receives an abnormal release message from the peer MSC after sending a Map_Prepare_Handover_Rsp message to the peer MSC.  [Problem root cause]:check the MML, the peer MSC number is 201179008244 and 201179008538 and 201179008537， but these MSC number not belong this MSC POOL  Need peer side to check why send abnormal release message after received Map_Prepare_Handover_Rsp message.[Solution]:from the shared Pcap trace it can confirm the output of CHRs.the UE HO from MSC 201179008538 to YHS16 and HO successthen YHS16 received HO from UE and the target LAC is 60203535 (belong to 201179008538 MSC):YHS16 will send MAP_PREPARE_HANDOVER_REQ to 201179008538 ,if received release from 201179008538 before HO completed, YHS16 will send HO reject and cause value is “call control”[Risk of Solution]:no risk
rows.resolution_summary: -	YHS16 is receiving release before handover completed, so you will notice that our MSC is rejecting with cause 9 Call Control.check with peer MSCs (GT: 201179008244, 201179008538 and 201179008537) the reason behind this rejection

rows.problem_summary: MQ Service Down.
rows.resolution_details: [Problem Summary]:On 2025-05-08, it was reported that NetEco MQ service down and client login failure.[Problem analysis]:NetEco has in-band networking sites and 4074 in-band channels. The system resources are overused due to version V600R023C00CP3106 issue that when the in-band channel is disconnected and reconnected, a new thread is created and cannot be released. As a result, the number of threads keeps increasing.Checked on PowerEcho, found that when the issue occurred, the number of threads of DPBinMedService reached around 30000, which is too large, new session cannot be created. caused the NetEco service unavailable. [Problem root cause]:Threads were continuously created due to in-band channel reconnection and cannot be released. As a result, when the number of threads exceeds the system threshold. Forced suspension of services. So NetEco service was abnormal and client login failure.[Solution]:1, Workaround:Restart all NetEco service.2, SolutionUpgrade to V600R023C00SPC501, which have fixed this issue, software link:https://support.huawei.com/carrier/navi?coltype=software#col=software&detailId=PBI1-266750472&path=PBI1-7921455/PBI1-21439559/PBI1-8482156/PBI1-251993099[Risk of Solution]:None of risk.

rows.title: Risk Investigation of Service Disruption Triggered by Unsupported IPv6 Packets Received by Routers in Specific Scenarios 关于路由器在特定场景下收到不支持的IPv6报文触发业务受损风险排查
rows.precaution_title: 关于路由器在特定场景下收到不支持的IPv6报文触发业务受损风险排查
rows.creator: l00203087
rows.risk_description:
[Disposal Method] :
1. Investigate whether the current network involves MPAC data configuration.
Investigation Plan 1 (Recommended): Use inspection tools to investigate, refer to "IPv6 Early Warning Collection and Analysis Guide (IP Toolkit + UMC)".
Investigation Plan 2 (Manual):
1.2.1) Execute the display version command under the user view to check if the device has any issues. The following versions are involved:
1.2.1.1) ATN&NE40E&CX600&ME60&NE8000&NE9000&NE20E&PTN6900&NetEngine A800: All versions of V800
1.2.1.2) ATN: All versions of V300
1.2.2) Execute display current-configuration under the user view to check for service-security policy ipv6 configuration. If present, there is a risk.
<HUAWEI>display current-configuration | include service-security
service-security policy ipv6 test1 //test1 is an example configuration name for MPAC IPv6 policy
2. If the current network devices have MPAC data configuration, provide feedback on the number of involved devices in the task progress, and track until the risk reduction is completed, then close the investigation task.
Risk reduction closure standard: Execute the preventive measures in the early warning or complete the upgrade of the current network devices according to the rectification requirements (rectification plan released online on August 10).
3. If the current network devices are not configured with MPAC, it is not involved. Provide feedback that it is not involved, and the investigation task can be directly closed.
If there are any questions during the risk investigation process, please contact the R&D interface person Wu Haimin at 00483639.

【处置方法】：
1、    排查现网是否涉及MPAC数据配置，
排查方案1（推荐）：通过巡检工具排查，参考《IPv6预警的采集和分析指导 (IP Toolkit + UMC)》
排查方案2（手工）：
             1.2.1）在用户视图下执行display version命令，查看设备是否存在问题。下列版本涉及：
                       1.2.1.1） ATN&NE40E&CX600&ME60&NE8000&NE9000&NE20E&PTN6900&NetEngine A800:V800所有版本
                       1.2.1.2）ATN:V300所有版本
            1.2.2) 在用户视图执行display current-configuration，查看有service-security policy ipv6配置，有则存在风险。
                  <HUAWEI>display current-configuration | include service-security 
                    service-security policy ipv6 test1  //test1是举例配置MPAC IPv6策略名
2、如果现网设备有MPAC数据配置，在任务进展中反馈涉及设备数量，并跟踪到风险消减完成，再闭环排查任务。
风险消减闭环标准：执行完成预警中的预防措施或者根据整改要求完成现网设备升级（整改计划8月10日发布上网）。
3、  如果现网设备未配置MPAC，则不涉及，反馈不涉及，排查任务可以直接闭环。 

如果在风险排查过程中有任何疑问，请联系研发接口人吴海民 00483639

The earliest expiration date for the OSS certificates is March 9, 2027. rows.risk_description:
Background: Major faults occur on the live network caused by multiple known problems due to factors such as inaccurate IBMS data and missing rectification implementation. To eliminate risks that need to be rectified, this project is developed

Special Solution: Sort out the rectifications released in Datacom domain in the past three years, to match IBMS inventory, UMC risks and RFC, identify the list of suspected sites that have not been rectified, and track and clear the sites through this special maintenance tasks

Closure Condition:

For NEs that have been rectified on the live network:
1. If the NE information is consistent with that in the IBMS, can close the CPT task directly. Remark as "The NEs have been rectified and the IBMS has been updated". The closure condition is to upload the screenshot of the current IB information in the CPT task

2. If the NE information is inconsistent with that in the IBMS, the IBMS needs to be updated. The closure condition is to upload the screenshot of the updated IB information in the CPT task

For NEs that have not been rectified on the live network:
1. If the customer agree to implement the rectification, complete the rectification in 2025 and update the IBMS.

rows.title: 关于华为服务器产品预置SSL证书过期的风险通知

rows.creator: h84185509
rows.risk_description:
The preset SSL certificate of iBMC earlier than 253 (excluded) and iBMC 663 will expire on July 22, 2024. The preset SSL certificate of E9000 management module (MM910) firmware earlier than 690 (excluded) will expire on February 20, 2024. The preset SSL certificate of all versions of 9008 V5 (supporting CMC)/9032/9016/9008 server chassis management modules (KunLun CMC) will expire on February 20, 2024. After the software certificates expire, the WebUI and Redfish functions can be used properly. Some software or versions will report alarms.
iBMC 253(不包含)之前和663版本使用的预置SSL证书将于2024年7月22日过期；E9000管理板MM910固件版本690(不包含)之前版本使用的预置SSL证书将于2024年2月20日过期；9008 V5（Support CMC）/9032/9016/9008服务器机框管理板Kunlun CMC所有版本使用的预置SSL证书2024年2月20日过期。这些软件的证书过期后，web和redfish功能均可以正常使用，部分软件或版本会上报告警。如果客户网管开启了证书有效期校验，可能有脱管风险。

rows.title: 电信云数据第三方备份/Telecom Cloud Data Third-Party Backup
rows.precaution_title: 电信云数据第三方备份
rows.creator: y00543860
rows.risk_description:
多国多运营商陆续出现CloudOS故障，网元虚拟机故障或者丢失，所有上层业务受损或完全中断，由于局点未进行I层数据的第三方备份，业务受损时间长、甚至只能重新部署，局点业务恢复时间不可控。
23年作为TOPN专项任务与各区域CS业务主管，高督做专题沟通。通过NETCARE的风险运营中心按照涉及客户群下发任务到各代表处并进行进展跟踪，专项执行过程中问题通过ITR流程支持，本次要求电信云C面全部实现第三方数据备份。
跟踪闭环措施:
1.电信云第三方备份专项任务关闭必须关联RFC单。
2.将FS、FSOM和Fusionstage数据备份成功任务截图上传TOPN任务，任务可闭环，如果有多个DC，可以将截图按DC站点名字区分，一起上传。
3.如果客户不批准第三方备份，上传客户不同意邮件
Cloud OS faults occur in multiple countries and carriers. The VM of NE is faulty or lost, all upper-layer services are damaged or completely interrupted. As the third-party data backup at the IaaS layer is not performed at the site, the service interruption time is long or even the site needs to be redeployed. The service restoration time is uncontrollable.
Communicated with regional CS business directors and senior supervisors as a special task for TOPN in 2023. The NetCare assigns tasks to rep offices based on the customer groups involved and tracks the progress, the TOP N must be resolved through the ITR process，all C plane of Telcom Cloud must finish third-party data backup,
Tracking and closed-loop measures:
1. The third-party backup task of the telecom cloud must be associated with RFC ticket.
2.Upload the screenshots of successful data backup tasks of FusionSphere, FusionSphere OM, and FusionStage to the top N tasks. The tasks can be closed. If there are multiple DCs, the screenshots can be separated by DC site name and uploaded together.
3.If customer don’t approve the third-party backup, upload customer email

rows.title: Risk of Digital Certificate Expiration
rows.creator: f00199581
rows.risk_description:
【NE involved】
All BSC6900/6910 controller & All 2/3/4/5 G sites

[Problem Description]
A preconfigured certificate is issued by the vendor's CA and is used only to establish an initial secure channel for devices to access the customer network during deployment. According to 3GPP TS 33.310, the certificate preconfigured by the vendor must be replaced with the operator certificate before commercial use. Currently, a large number of devices on the carrier's network still use Huawei pre-configured certificates. In October 2024, the preconfigured certificates of nearly 3000 base station controllers will expire. After the certificates expire, the OMCH between the base station controllers and the U2000 will be disconnected.

【Solution】
1: Deploy operator-own CA
2. Deploy MAE LiteCA

【Guide】：http://3ms.huawei.com/km/groups/2026591/blogs/details/13748395?l=zh-cn&moduleId=732999204558016512&ctype=-1

【Risk mitigation and confirmation】
(1) Collect all wireless NE data for HQ/Romania GTAC to analyze certificate risk.
(2) Complete risk mitigation based on the customer's mitigation solution and plan (refer to the task/risk closure conditions), in the guide.
(3) Frontline engineers collect controller data on live network again and HQ analyzes the data and confirms that the controller certificate has been replaced.

rows.title: Notice on Hardening GU Controller Reliability to enhance the network anti-risk capability.
rows.precaution_title: Notice on Hardening GU Controller Reliability to enhance the network anti-risk capability.
rows.creator: f00199581
rows.risk_description:
heck whether below risk existing in current network or not. if yes, record risk in system to follow up

[Problem Scenario]:Power terminals are carbonized and burnt at multiple sites in high-temperature countries.
[Fault Symptom]:In high-temperature areas, the power terminals of high-power modules are carbonized and burnt.
[Trigger Condition]:1. The stripped length of the power cable is insufficient.The contact resistance becomes large after the insulation layer is pressed. As a result, the power cable is overheated and burnt. 2. The power cable at the ground clip is not well-made and has no shield layer. The insulation of the cable is damaged and short-circuited with the ground clip.

[Check Method]:
1. For sites earlier than SRAN17.1SPC180, extract central-layer fault logs(section 2.4 in the guide) and inventory files(section 2.2 in the guide).
2. In SRAN17.1SPC180 and later versions, the resistance detection solution is incorporated to identify risky sites based on power supply alarm monitoring. RFTEST logs(section 2.6 in the guide) and inventory files(section 2.2 in the guide) need to be extracted to accurately identify high-risk sites.
3、Send the collected inventory files and central-layer fault logs/RFTEST logs to Zhou Cai 0051065 for data analysis.
Refer to the below link for details,
http://3ms.huawei.com/hi/group/2026591/file_17561981.html?for_statistic_from=my_group_file
If you have any questions, contact Ma Chunlei (00330741) and Zhang Tianbo (00621356).
